painful-sex-vaginismus-treatable.en:
Imagine a 24-year-old in Kanpur, four months into an arranged marriage. Every attempt at sex ends the same way: a burning pain, her body closing like a fist, and her husband turning away in silence. Her mother says it hurts for everyone at first. Nobody says the word "doctor".

This is a hypothetical, but the script is familiar. In many Indian homes a wife's pain during sex is filed under "adjustment". It is a medical symptom, and its cause can usually be found and treated.

## Is pain during sex normal?

Common, yes. Normal, no. Pain is the body reporting a problem: too little arousal or lubrication, an infection, a hormonal change, a condition such as endometriosis, or muscles that tighten on their own [[nhs-vaginismus]]. None of these is fixed by enduring it.

The "first night" story does damage here. Girls are told that first-time sex must hurt and bleed, so pain gets treated as proof of virtue. The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex, and bleeding, or its absence, proves nothing. First-time pain is often linked to fear, hurry and dryness, and none of these has to be part of sex.

Men are not exempt: a tight foreskin can cause painful erections that make sex difficult [[nhs-tight-foreskin]]. The rule is the same for every body. If it hurts, stop. Pushing through can make the fear, and the pain, worse.

## What is vaginismus, and why does it happen?

Vaginismus is when the muscles around the vagina suddenly tighten, by reflex, as something is about to enter: a penis, a finger, a tampon, a doctor's instrument. It can cause burning or stinging pain, or make penetration impossible. The tightening is automatic: she is not doing it and cannot simply decide to stop [[nhs-vaginismus]].

It does not mean her vagina is too small or that she does not love her partner. Vaginismus does not necessarily affect arousal, and it can appear even in someone who has had painless sex before [[nhs-vaginismus]].

The cause is not always clear. The NHS lists fear or anxiety about sex, a painful earlier experience, sexual assault or abuse, an unpleasant medical examination or a difficult birth, a painful condition such as thrush, and believing that sex is shameful or wrong [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Read the last one again. A girl who is told for twenty years that sex is dirty, is never taught the names of her own body parts, and is then expected to perform on a decorated bed with a near-stranger has been prepared for vaginismus, not for marriage.

## Could it be an infection, dryness, childbirth or menopause?

Often, yes, which is why the first step is an examination, not a diagnosis by relatives. Besides vaginismus, the NHS lists thrush, sexually transmitted infections (STIs), menopause, reactions to condoms or soaps, pelvic inflammatory disease and endometriosis among the causes of pain during sex [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Burning or itching with unusual discharge points to an infection. Many STIs cause no symptoms at all, so only a test can rule one out [[who-sti]]. Dryness follows hurry or low arousal, and hormonal change after childbirth or around menopause, when vaginal dryness and pain during intercourse are recognised symptoms [[who-menopause]]. Deep pain, especially alongside severe period pain, can be a sign of endometriosis [[who-endometriosis]].

None of these is treated by an oil, a tonic or advice to "relax".

## Everyone says a wife must 'adjust'. Is that true?

No. But here medicine meets something harder than muscle.

In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 12.2% of Indian men aged 15-49, about one in eight, said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses. Another 19.2% said he has the right to get angry and reprimand her. The share of men who rejected every coercive response the survey listed fell from 77% in NFHS-4 to 72% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In the same survey, 6% of ever-married women aged 18-49 said they had faced sexual violence by a husband, a face-to-face answer that is likely an undercount [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Put a woman with vaginismus into that marriage. Her body says no before she can speak. If her husband is among the one in eight, her medical condition becomes "refusal". Force does not cure a reflex. It confirms the fear that drives it.

> A body that tightens in fear is not refusing a duty. It is reporting a problem that has a treatment.

Criminal law gives her little: under Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, forced sex by a husband with a wife aged 18 or older is still not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A challenge to that exception is pending in the Supreme Court. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 does count sexual abuse as domestic violence [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

The World Health Organization's idea of sexual health includes sexual experiences that are pleasurable and safe, and free of coercion, discrimination and violence [[who-sexual-health]]. Consent and comfort come first. A wedding does not change the order.

## What treatment works, and how do I ask for it?

Start with a gynaecologist; you do not have to be married to go. The examination is usually brief and checks for infection and other physical causes. You can ask for a woman doctor and take someone you trust.

For vaginismus, treatment works on the fear of penetration and on the muscles, which learn step by step that they can let go. The NHS lists psychosexual therapy, relaxation techniques, pelvic-floor exercises, sensate focus exercises, and vaginal trainers: tampon-shaped objects in graduated sizes, used at your own pace, first with a specialist's guidance and then at home [[nhs-vaginismus]]. None of it involves force or "trying harder".

Infections need the right medicine. Dryness is helped by a water-based lubricant and more time. Menopausal symptoms have hormonal and non-hormonal treatments [[who-menopause]].

If saying it aloud is the obstacle, type it on your phone and hand it over: "Sex is painful or impossible for me. I think it may be vaginismus. Please tell me my options." A doctor who replies that it will be fine after a baby is wrong. See another one.

If you are the husband or partner: her pain is not a verdict on you. Stop when it hurts, ask what she wants, and go to the appointment if she wants you there.
painful-sex-vaginismus-treatable.hg:
Sochiye, Kanpur ki ek 24 saal ki ladki, arranged marriage ko chaar mahine hue hain. Sex ki har koshish ek hi tarah khatam hoti hai: jalan jaisa dard, uska shareer mutthi ki tarah band ho jaata hai, aur pati chup-chaap munh pher leta hai. Maa kehti hai shuru mein sabko dard hota hai. "Doctor" shabd koi nahi bolta.

Yeh ek hypothetical hai, lekin script jaani-pehchaani hai. Kai Indian gharon mein sex ke dauraan biwi ke dard ko "adjustment" ke khaate mein daal diya jaata hai. Yeh ek medical symptom hai, aur aam taur par iski wajah dhoondhi ja sakti hai aur ilaaj ho sakta hai.

## Kya sex ke dauraan dard normal hai?

Common hai, haan. Normal nahi. Dard ka matlab hai ki shareer kisi problem ki khabar de raha hai: arousal ya lubrication kam hona, koi infection, hormones mein badlaav, endometriosis jaisi condition, ya woh muscles jo apne aap tight ho jaate hain [[nhs-vaginismus]]. Inmein se kuch bhi sehte rehne se theek nahi hota.

"Pehli raat" wali kahaani yahan kaafi nuksaan karti hai. Ladkiyon ko bataya jaata hai ki pehli baar sex mein dard hona hi hai aur khoon aana hi hai, isliye dard ko "achchi ladki" hone ka saboot maan liya jaata hai. Hymen yeh nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi, aur khoon aana ya na aana kuch bhi saabit nahi karta. Pehli baar ka dard aksar darr, jaldbaazi aur dryness se juda hota hai, aur inmein se koi bhi sex ka zaroori hissa nahi hai.

Mard bhi isse bahar nahi hain: tight foreskin se erection mein dard ho sakta hai, jisse sex mushkil ho jaata hai [[nhs-tight-foreskin]]. Rule har shareer ke liye ek hi hai. Dard ho toh ruk jaiye. Dard ke bawajood zor lagane se darr, aur dard, dono badh sakte hain.

## Vaginismus kya hai, aur yeh kyun hota hai?

Vaginismus tab hota hai jab vagina ke aas-paas ke muscles achanak, reflex ki tarah, tight ho jaate hain, jaise hi kuch andar jaane wala hota hai: penis, ungli, tampon ya doctor ka instrument. Isse jalan ya chubhan jaisa dard ho sakta hai, ya penetration ho hi nahi paata. Yeh tightening automatic hoti hai: woh aisa jaan-boojhkar nahi kar rahi, aur sirf chaah lene se ise rok bhi nahi sakti [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki uski vagina bahut chhoti hai, ya woh apne partner se pyaar nahi karti. Vaginismus ka arousal par asar padna zaroori nahi, aur yeh us insaan ko bhi ho sakta hai jise pehle bina dard ke sex hua ho [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Wajah hamesha saaf nahi hoti. NHS ki list mein hai: sex ko lekar darr ya anxiety, pehle ka koi dardnaak experience, sexual assault ya abuse, koi takleef-deh medical examination ya mushkil delivery, thrush jaisi dard wali condition, aur yeh maanna ki sex sharmnaak ya galat hai [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Aakhri wajah ek baar phir padhiye. Jis ladki ko bees saal tak yeh bataya jaaye ki sex gandi cheez hai, jise apne hi body parts ke naam tak na sikhaye jaayein, aur phir usse ummeed ki jaaye ki woh saji hui sej par ek lagbhag anjaan aadmi ke saath sab kuch kar legi, use vaginismus ke liye taiyaar kiya gaya hai, shaadi ke liye nahi.

## Kya yeh infection, dryness, delivery ya menopause ki wajah se ho sakta hai?

Aksar, haan, aur isiliye pehla step examination hai, rishtedaaron ka diagnosis nahi. Vaginismus ke alawa NHS sex ke dauraan dard ki wajahon mein thrush, sexually transmitted infections (STIs), menopause, condom ya sabun se reaction, pelvic inflammatory disease aur endometriosis ko ginta hai [[nhs-vaginismus]].

Jalan ya khujli ke saath ajeeb discharge ho toh infection ka shak hota hai. Kai STIs mein koi symptom hota hi nahi, isliye sirf test hi bata sakta hai ki infection hai ya nahi [[who-sti]]. Dryness jaldbaazi ya kam arousal se hoti hai, aur delivery ke baad ya menopause ke aas-paas hormones badalne se bhi, jab vaginal dryness aur intercourse mein dard jaane-maane symptoms hain [[who-menopause]]. Andar gehraai mein dard, khaaskar agar periods mein bhi bahut tez dard hota ho, endometriosis ka sanket ho sakta hai [[who-endometriosis]].

Inmein se kisi ka bhi ilaaj tel, tonic ya "relax karo" wali salaah se nahi hota.

## Sab kehte hain biwi ko 'adjust' karna padta hai. Kya yeh sach hai?

Nahi. Lekin yahan medicine ka saamna ek aisi cheez se hota hai jo muscle se zyada sakht hai.

NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-49 saal ke 12.2% Indian mardon ne, yaani lagbhag aath mein se ek ne, kaha ki agar biwi sex se mana kare toh pati ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai. Aur 19.2% ne kaha ki pati ko gussa hone aur use daantne ka haq hai. Survey mein diye gaye har zabardasti wale response ko galat maanne wale mardon ka hissa NFHS-4 ke 77% se girkar 72% reh gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Isi survey mein 18-49 saal ki 6% ever-married aurton ne kaha ki unhone pati ke haathon sexual violence jheli hai, aur aamne-saamne ke interview mein diya gaya yeh jawab asli sankhya se kam hi hoga [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Ab vaginismus wali aurat ko aisi shaadi mein rakh kar dekhiye. Uske bolne se pehle hi uska shareer na keh deta hai. Agar uska pati un aath mein se ek hai, toh uski medical condition "inkaar" ban jaati hai. Zabardasti se reflex theek nahi hota. Usse wahi darr pakka hota hai jo is reflex ko chalata hai.

> Jo shareer darr se tight ho jaata hai, woh koi farz nibhaane se mana nahi kar raha. Woh ek aisi problem ki khabar de raha hai jiska ilaaj hai.

Criminal law use zyada kuch nahi deta: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 63 ke Exception 2 ke tahat, 18 saal ya usse badi biwi ke saath pati ka zabardasti sex aaj bhi rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Is exception ke khilaaf ek challenge Supreme Court mein pending hai. Haan, Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 sexual abuse ko domestic violence zaroor maanta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

World Health Organization ke hisaab se sexual health mein aise sexual experiences shaamil hain jo sukhad aur safe hon, aur zabardasti, bhedbhaav aur violence se azaad hon [[who-sexual-health]]. Consent aur comfort pehle aate hain. Shaadi se yeh order nahi badalta.

## Kaun sa ilaaj kaam karta hai, aur main iske liye kaise poochun?

Shuruaat gynaecologist se kijiye; iske liye shaadishuda hona zaroori nahi. Examination aam taur par chhota hota hai aur usme infection aur doosri physical wajahein check ki jaati hain. Aap mahila doctor maang sakti hain aur kisi bharose wale ko saath le ja sakti hain.

Vaginismus ka ilaaj do cheezon par kaam karta hai: penetration ka darr, aur muscles, jo step by step seekhte hain ki woh dheele pad sakte hain. NHS ki list mein psychosexual therapy, relaxation techniques, pelvic-floor exercises, sensate focus exercises aur vaginal trainers hain: tampon jaisi shape ki cheezein, chhote se bade size mein, jinhe aap apni raftaar se use karti hain, pehle specialist ki guidance mein aur phir ghar par [[nhs-vaginismus]]. Isme kahin zabardasti nahi hai, aur "thoda aur try karo" bhi nahi.

Infection ke liye sahi dawa chahiye. Dryness mein water-based lubricant aur zyada time se madad milti hai. Menopause ke symptoms ke liye hormonal aur non-hormonal dono tarah ke ilaaj hain [[who-menopause]].

Agar bolkar kehna hi sabse mushkil hai, toh phone par type karke doctor ko phone pakda dijiye: "Mere liye sex dardnaak ya namumkin hai. Mujhe lagta hai yeh vaginismus ho sakta hai. Please mujhe mere options bataiye." Jo doctor jawab de ki bachcha hone ke baad sab theek ho jaayega, woh galat hai. Doosre doctor ke paas jaiye.

Agar aap pati ya partner hain: uska dard aapke baare mein koi faisla nahi hai. Dard ho toh ruk jaiye, poochiye ki woh kya chahti hai, aur woh chahe toh appointment par saath jaiye.

premarital-hiv-syphilis-testing-couples.en:
Imagine a couple in Indore with the wedding date fixed. The families have matched kundlis, compared salaries and asked about each other's relatives. Nobody has mentioned a blood test, and the two of them are too embarrassed to bring it up. This Q&A is for them, and for anyone who has wondered whether to ask. It is general information, not legal or medical advice.

## Why do families match horoscopes but not health?

Because sexual health is treated as a question about character instead of bodies. The data says otherwise. In 2024-25, 83.9% of people living with HIV in India knew their status, so roughly one in six did not [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Many sexually transmitted infections cause no symptoms at all, and only a test can tell [[who-sti]]. Feeling fine proves nothing, about anyone.

Marriage is not a shield either. Of 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in India in 2024-25, 26.5% reported sex with a regular partner as the route, 32.1% sex with casual partners and 15.1% with commercial partners [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. These answers are self-reported and stigma hides some routes. NACO does not separate spouses from other regular partners, but more than a quarter of new diagnoses came through a steady relationship, not a casual one.

Syphilis tells the same story from the other end. India identified 10,545 pregnant women with syphilis in 2024-25, double the 5,228 found in 2021-22, a rise that largely reflects more testing [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Every one of those infections was found during a pregnancy, when a baby was already on the way.

## Which tests should we take, and where?

Three blood tests cover the infections that matter most before marriage and pregnancy:

- **HIV.** Offered at HIV counselling and testing centres in government hospitals; NACO's helpline 1097 can tell you the nearest one [[naco]]. A very recent exposure may not show up yet; the counsellor will tell you whether you need a repeat test [[who-hiv]].
- **Syphilis.** A simple blood test, and the infection is curable with antibiotics [[who-sti]]. NACO runs 1,127 designated STI clinics, branded Suraksha Clinics, in district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- **Hepatitis B.** A blood test shows whether you carry the virus. If one partner does and the other is not protected, the other can be vaccinated with a safe and effective vaccine [[who-hepb]].

Ask the doctor whether other STI tests make sense for you, since some need different samples. Going to the same centre on the same day keeps it simple and equal.

## Can a family force the test? What the HIV Act says

No. India's HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 forbids any HIV test without the informed consent of the person tested (Section 5). No one can be compelled to disclose their HIV status except by court order (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. A test run on someone's blood without their informed consent breaks the law, whoever arranged it.

The Act also forbids making an HIV test a condition for a job, healthcare or education, and bans discrimination against people with HIV and those who live with them (Section 3) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]].

So a premarital test works only one way: two adults choose it, and each decides who sees the result. The fairest deal is simple. Both test. Both share with each other. Neither shares with anyone else, including parents, without the other's consent.

## How do we bring it up without it sounding like an accusation?

Make it about the future, not the past. One strong reason to test is the children you may want to have. In 2024-25, only 77% of pregnant women in India were tested for syphilis, against 84% for HIV [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. That year an estimated 10.25% of babies born to mothers with HIV, roughly 1 in 10, still acquired the virus [[naco-sankalak-2025]], although treatment during pregnancy, birth and breastfeeding greatly lowers that risk [[who-hiv]]. Knowing before a pregnancy gives you time.

Some ways to say it:

- "I'm getting my tests done before the wedding. Will you come with me and do yours too?"
- "We matched our kundlis for the family we want. Let's do this for the same reason."
- "I'll go first and show you my results."

If your families are involved, the two of you can still decide this between yourselves first. A test you both chose is worth more than one you were pushed into.

## What if one of us tests positive?

Then you found it in time, which is the whole point.

- **Syphilis** is cured with antibiotics, and both partners should be treated so it does not pass back and forth [[who-sti]]. Of the 10,545 pregnant women found with syphilis in 2024-25, 86% received treatment [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. A test before pregnancy means treatment can start before a baby is involved.
- **HIV** treatment is free at 800 government ART centres [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Taken daily, it usually makes the virus undetectable, and a person who stays undetectable does not pass HIV on through sex. With treatment, people with HIV can marry and have HIV-negative children [[who-hiv]]. The partner should be tested too: in 2024-25, 4.1% of the 6.6 lakh spouses, partners and children of people with HIV who were tested had the virus [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- **Hepatitis B** can be managed with medical care, a partner can be vaccinated, and babies should get the vaccine soon after birth [[who-hepb]].

A positive result is not proof of cheating. An infection can be years old, picked up before the two of you met, or passed on through blood or at birth. Whether to go ahead with the wedding is your decision, not a verdict the test makes for you. For confidential advice, NACO's helpline 1097 is free and works round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
premarital-hiv-syphilis-testing-couples.hg:
Socho Indore ka ek couple, jinki shaadi ki date fix ho chuki hai. Families ne kundli mila li, salary compare kar li, aur ek doosre ke rishtedaaron ke baare mein sab pooch liya. Blood test ki baat kisi ne nahi ki, aur dono khud itne jhijhak rahe hain ki baat chhed hi nahi pa rahe. Yeh Q&A unke liye hai, aur har us insaan ke liye jisne kabhi socha ho ki poochein ya nahi. Yeh general information hai, legal ya medical advice nahi.

## Families kundli toh milati hain, health kyun nahi?

Kyunki sexual health ko body ka nahi, character ka sawaal maana jaata hai. Data kuch aur kehta hai. 2024-25 mein India mein HIV ke saath jee rahe 83.9% logon ko apna status pata tha, yaani lagbhag har chhe mein se ek ko nahi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Kai sexually transmitted infections ke koi symptoms hi nahi hote, aur sirf test se pata chalta hai [[who-sti]]. Theek feel karna kisi ke baare mein kuch saabit nahi karta.

Shaadi bhi koi kavach nahi hai. 2024-25 mein India mein naye diagnosed 1,63,306 HIV cases mein se 26.5% ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya, 32.1% ne casual partners aur 15.1% ne commercial partners ke saath sex ko [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh jawab log khud batate hain aur stigma ki wajah se kuch routes chhup jaate hain. NACO spouses ko baaki regular partners se alag nahi ginta, lekin naye diagnoses mein se ek chauthai se zyada kisi casual nahi, balki steady relationship se aaye.

Syphilis doosri taraf se wahi kahani batata hai. 2024-25 mein India ne 10,545 pregnant women mein syphilis pehchaana, jo 2021-22 ke 5,228 ka double hai, aur yeh badhat zyada tar zyada testing ki wajah se hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. In sabhi infections ka pata pregnancy ke dauraan chala, jab baby pehle se raaste mein tha.

## Kaun se tests karwayein, aur kahan?

Teen blood tests un infections ko cover karte hain jo shaadi aur pregnancy se pehle sabse zyada maayne rakhte hain:

- **HIV.** Government hospitals ke HIV counselling aur testing centres mein hota hai; NACO ki helpline 1097 sabse paas wala centre bata sakti hai [[naco]]. Bilkul haal ka exposure shayad abhi test mein na dikhe; counsellor bata denge ki repeat test chahiye ya nahi [[who-hiv]].
- **Syphilis.** Ek simple blood test, aur yeh infection antibiotics se theek ho jaata hai [[who-sti]]. NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 designated STI clinics chalata hai, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kehte hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- **Hepatitis B.** Blood test batata hai ki tumhare andar yeh virus hai ya nahi. Agar ek partner mein hai aur doosra protected nahi hai, toh doosre ko ek safe aur effective vaccine lag sakti hai [[who-hepb]].

Doctor se poocho ki kya tumhare liye aur STI tests bhi sense banate hain, kyunki kuch ke liye alag samples lagte hain. Ek hi din ek hi centre par jaana cheezein simple aur barabar rakhta hai.

## Kya family test ke liye force kar sakti hai? HIV Act kya kehta hai

Nahi. India ka HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 kisi bhi HIV test ko us insaan ki informed consent ke bina mana karta hai (Section 5). Court order ke bina kisi ko apna HIV status batane ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Kisi ke blood par uski informed consent ke bina kiya gaya test law todta hai, chahe use kisi ne bhi arrange kiya ho.

Act HIV test ko naukri, healthcare ya education ki shart banane ko bhi mana karta hai, aur HIV wale logon aur unke saath rehne walon ke saath bhedbhaav par rok lagata hai (Section 3) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]].

Toh premarital test sirf ek hi tarah kaam karta hai: do adults ise khud chunte hain, aur dono tay karte hain ki result kaun dekhega. Sabse fair deal simple hai. Dono test karwayein. Dono ek doosre se share karein. Doosre ki consent ke bina koi kisi aur ko na bataye, parents ko bhi nahi.

## Baat kaise shuru karein taaki ilzaam jaisa na lage?

Baat future ki karo, past ki nahi. Test ki ek mazboot wajah woh bachche hain jo tum shayad chahte ho. 2024-25 mein India mein sirf 77% pregnant women ka syphilis test hua, jabki HIV test 84% ka [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Usi saal HIV wali maaon se paida hone wale estimated 10.25% babies ko, yaani lagbhag har 10 mein se 1 ko, ab bhi virus mila [[naco-sankalak-2025]], jabki pregnancy, delivery aur breastfeeding ke dauraan treatment is risk ko kaafi kam kar deta hai [[who-hiv]]. Pregnancy se pehle pata ho toh tumhare paas waqt hota hai.

Kehne ke kuch tareeke:

- "Main shaadi se pehle apne tests karwa raha hoon. Tum bhi mere saath chaloge aur apne karwaoge?"
- "Humne jis family ke liye kundli milayi, usi ke liye yeh bhi karte hain."
- "Pehle main karwa leti hoon aur tumhe apne results dikha deti hoon."

Agar families involved hain, tab bhi tum dono pehle aapas mein yeh tay kar sakte ho. Jo test tum dono ne milkar chuna, woh dabaav mein karwaye gaye test se zyada keemti hai.

## Agar hum mein se kisi ka result positive aaye toh?

Toh tumne ise waqt par pakad liya, aur poora maqsad yahi tha.

- **Syphilis** antibiotics se theek ho jaata hai, aur dono partners ka ilaaj hona chahiye taaki yeh aage-peeche na hota rahe [[who-sti]]. 2024-25 mein syphilis wali 10,545 pregnant women mein se 86% ko treatment mila [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Pregnancy se pehle test hone ka matlab hai ki baby ke aane se pehle hi ilaaj shuru ho sakta hai.
- **HIV** ka treatment 800 government ART centres par free hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Roz lene par yeh usually virus ko undetectable kar deta hai, aur jo insaan undetectable bana rehta hai woh sex ke through HIV aage nahi deta. Treatment ke saath HIV wale log shaadi kar sakte hain aur unke HIV-negative bachche ho sakte hain [[who-hiv]]. Partner ka test bhi hona chahiye: 2024-25 mein HIV wale logon ke 6.6 lakh spouses, partners aur bachchon ka test hua, aur unmein se 4.1% mein virus nikla [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- **Hepatitis B** ko medical care se manage kiya ja sakta hai, partner ko vaccine lag sakti hai, aur babies ko janam ke turant baad vaccine milni chahiye [[who-hepb]].

Positive result cheating ka saboot nahi hai. Infection saalon purana ho sakta hai, tum dono ke milne se pehle ka, ya blood se ya janam ke waqt aaya hua. Shaadi aage badhani hai ya nahi, yeh tumhara faisla hai, test ka verdict nahi. Confidential salah ke liye NACO ki helpline 1097 free hai aur din-raat 16 languages mein chalti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

premature-ejaculation-questions-answered.en:
Imagine a 24-year-old in Pune, three months into his first serious relationship. Most times he and his girlfriend have sex, he ejaculates soon after they start, sometimes before. He has watched enough porn to believe other men can go on for as long as they like. He has told neither her nor a doctor how he feels. Late at night, his feed shows him an ad for a "timing" capsule with a money-back guarantee. Here are the questions he is too embarrassed to ask, answered with medical evidence instead of marketing.

## What counts as "too quick"?

Premature ejaculation (PE) means ejaculating sooner than you or your partner would like during sex. Ejaculation problems are common in men, and PE is one of the main types [[nhs-ejaculation]].

There is no stopwatch test. Occasional episodes are common and not a cause for concern; nerves at the start of a new relationship are a typical trigger [[nhs-ejaculation]]. It is worth getting help when it happens more often than you would like and it has become a problem for you [[nhs-ejaculation]].

And the benchmark many young men carry in their heads is not real. Pornography is edited, staged and performed. It tells you as much about real sex as an action film tells you about real fights.

Some men have had PE ever since they became sexually active; for others it starts suddenly after years without a problem [[nhs-ejaculation]].

## Why does it happen?

Causes can be psychological, physical or both:

- **Anxiety about performance:** especially at the start of a new relationship, or after it has gone wrong before [[nhs-ejaculation]]. The fear of finishing early can feed the problem.
- **Stress, depression and relationship problems** [[nhs-ejaculation]].
- **Early habits:** a teenager who learned to ejaculate quickly so he would not be caught masturbating, perhaps in a crowded home with no privacy, may find the habit hard to break later. A past traumatic sexual experience, or a strict upbringing and beliefs about sex, can also play a part [[nhs-ejaculation]].
- **Physical causes:** prostate or thyroid problems, or using recreational drugs [[nhs-ejaculation]].

None of this says anything about character or manhood. Masturbation has not "weakened" anything, and PE is not a punishment for it. If something that happened to you in the past is part of the picture, a counsellor can help with that too.

## What actually works?

PE can be treated, and the first steps need no capsule.

**Techniques.** In the stop-start (or "stop-go") technique, you stop stimulation before the point of ejaculation, wait, then carry on. The squeeze technique adds squeezing the head of the penis at that point before letting go. Both are practised during masturbation first and then, once you feel more confident, during sex. They sound simple but take a lot of practice [[nhs-ejaculation]]. Some men are also helped by masturbating an hour or two before sex, using a thick condom, or having sex with their partner on top, so the partner can pull away when he is close [[nhs-ejaculation]].

**Counselling.** Psychosexual counselling, with your partner if you have one, works on relationship issues and teaches these techniques to help you "unlearn" the habit [[nhs-ejaculation]].

**Prescribed medicine.** A doctor may suggest a numbing (anaesthetic) cream, which can also reduce a partner's sensation, or prescribe antidepressants called SSRIs, which also delay ejaculation. One of them, dapoxetine, is made for PE and is taken before sex rather than every day. Erection medicines such as sildenafil may also help [[nhs-ejaculation]]. These need a doctor: dapoxetine is not recommended for some men with heart, kidney or liver problems, and it can interact with other medicines, including other antidepressants [[nhs-ejaculation]].

## Are 'timing capsules' a scam, and are those ads even legal?

Treat any ad that promises guaranteed "timing", "stamina" or "double duration" as a red flag. You do not know what the capsule contains, in what dose, or how it mixes with your other medicines.

The ads are also illegal. Section 3 of the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 bans advertising any drug for "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure" [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. A first conviction can bring up to six months in jail, a fine or both [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

The law is old; enforcement is the problem. On 26 March 2025, in Indian Medical Association v. Union of India, the Supreme Court said that "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit". It gave states one month to appoint enforcement officers and two months to set up a way for the public to complain, such as a toll-free number or email [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Ask your state's drug control or health department for it.

The bigger cost is time. Every month spent on capsules is a month not spent on the techniques and counselling that actually change things, and another month of growing shame.

## How do I talk to my partner, and where do I get help?

Talk outside the bedroom, not in the awkward minutes after. Say what is happening, that it is common and treatable, and that you are doing something about it. Ask what your partner enjoys: closeness and attention are part of good sex, not only how long it lasts. Sex is not only penetration; touch, oral sex and taking turns let both people enjoy it without a clock.

Then get help:

- A general physician, urologist or psychiatrist can assess you confidentially. "Sexologist" on a signboard is not by itself a medical qualification, so check for a medical degree and a state medical council registration.
- If anxiety or low mood is behind it, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, running since October 2022 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]] [[tele-manas]].

Most people in India who need mental health care do not seek it. The National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 estimated that nearly 150 million Indians needed mental health care but fewer than 30 million sought it [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. A problem as common as PE should not need courage to discuss. It needs one honest conversation and one appointment.
premature-ejaculation-questions-answered.hg:
Socho, Pune mein ek 24 saal ka ladka hai, apne pehle serious relationship mein teen mahine se. Zyada tar jab wo aur uski girlfriend sex karte hain, wo shuru hote hi jaldi ejaculate kar deta hai, kabhi-kabhi shuru hone se pehle hi. Usne itna porn dekha hai ki use lagta hai baaki aadmi jitni der chahein utni der tik sakte hain. Usne na girlfriend ko bataya hai ki wo kya feel karta hai, na kisi doctor ko. Raat ko der se uski feed pe ek "timing" capsule ka ad aata hai, money-back guarantee ke saath. Neeche wahi sawaal hain jo wo sharam ke maare pooch nahi paata, aur unke jawab marketing se nahi, medical evidence se.

## "Bahut jaldi" kise kehte hain?

Premature ejaculation (PE) ka matlab hai sex ke dauraan us waqt se pehle ejaculate ho jaana jab tum ya tumhara partner chahte ho. Men mein ejaculation ki problems common hain, aur PE inke main types mein se ek hai [[nhs-ejaculation]].

Iska koi stopwatch test nahi hai. Kabhi-kabhar aisa hona common hai aur chinta ki baat nahi; naye relationship ki shuruaat ki ghabrahat iski ek aam wajah hai [[nhs-ejaculation]]. Help lena tab sahi hai jab ye tumhari marzi se zyada baar hone lage aur tumhare liye problem ban jaaye [[nhs-ejaculation]].

Aur jo benchmark bahut se ladke dimaag mein le ke ghoomte hain, wo real hi nahi hai. Porn edited hota hai, stage kiya jaata hai, perform kiya jaata hai. Wo real sex ke baare mein utna hi sach batata hai jitna ek action film real ladaai ke baare mein.

Kuch aadmiyon ko PE tab se hai jab se wo sexually active hue; kuch mein ye saalon tak koi problem na hone ke baad achaanak shuru hota hai [[nhs-ejaculation]].

## Ye hota kyun hai?

Wajahein psychological, physical ya dono ho sakti hain:

- **Performance ki anxiety:** khaaskar naye relationship ki shuruaat mein, ya pehle gadbad ho chuki ho tab [[nhs-ejaculation]]. Jaldi finish hone ka darr hi problem ko aur badha sakta hai.
- **Stress, depression aur rishte ki problems** [[nhs-ejaculation]].
- **Purani aadatein:** jo ladka teenage mein pakde jaane ke darr se jaldi ejaculate karna seekh gaya, shayad bheed wale ghar mein jahan privacy nahi thi, use baad mein wo aadat todna mushkil lag sakta hai. Pehle ka koi traumatic sexual experience, ya sex ko le ke sakht parvarish aur maanyataayein bhi isme role nibha sakti hain [[nhs-ejaculation]].
- **Physical wajahein:** prostate ya thyroid ki problems, ya recreational drugs ka use [[nhs-ejaculation]].

Inmein se koi bhi baat tumhare character ya mardaangi ke baare mein kuch nahi kehti. Masturbation ne kuch "kamzor" nahi kiya hai, aur PE uski koi saza nahi hai. Agar pehle tumhare saath kuch aisa hua hai jo is kahani ka hissa hai, toh counsellor usme bhi madad kar sakta hai.

## Asal mein kya kaam karta hai?

PE ka ilaaj ho sakta hai, aur shuruaati kadmon ke liye kisi capsule ki zaroorat nahi.

**Techniques.** Stop-start (ya "stop-go") technique mein, ejaculation ke point se pehle stimulation rok do, ruko, phir aage badho. Squeeze technique mein usi point pe penis ke head ko dabaya jaata hai, phir chhoda jaata hai. Dono pehle masturbation ke dauraan practice kiye jaate hain, aur jab confidence aa jaaye tab sex ke dauraan. Sunne mein aasaan lagte hain, par inme kaafi practice lagti hai [[nhs-ejaculation]]. Kuch aadmiyon ko sex se ek-do ghante pehle masturbate karne, mota condom use karne, ya aisi position se bhi fayda hota hai jisme partner upar ho, taaki jab wo ejaculation ke kareeb ho toh partner hat sake [[nhs-ejaculation]].

**Counselling.** Psychosexual counselling, agar partner hai toh uske saath, rishte ke issues pe kaam karti hai aur yahi techniques sikhaati hai taaki tum us aadat ko "unlearn" kar sako [[nhs-ejaculation]].

**Prescribe ki hui dawa.** Doctor ek numbing (anaesthetic) cream suggest kar sakte hain, jo partner ki sensation bhi kam kar sakti hai, ya SSRIs naam ki antidepressant dawaiyan de sakte hain jo ejaculation ko der se karti hain. Inmein se ek, dapoxetine, khaas PE ke liye bani hai aur roz nahi, sex se pehle li jaati hai. Sildenafil jaisi erection ki dawaiyan bhi madad kar sakti hain [[nhs-ejaculation]]. Inke liye doctor zaroori hai: dapoxetine heart, kidney ya liver ki problem wale kuch aadmiyon ke liye recommended nahi hai, aur ye doosri dawaiyon ke saath, jinmein doosre antidepressants bhi hain, react kar sakti hai [[nhs-ejaculation]].

## Kya 'timing capsules' scam hain, aur kya ye ads legal bhi hain?

Jo bhi ad guaranteed "timing", "stamina" ya "double duration" ka waada kare, use red flag samjho. Tumhe nahi pata capsule mein kya hai, kitni dose hai, ya wo tumhari doosri dawaiyon ke saath kaise react karega.

Ye ads illegal bhi hain. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 ka Section 3 kisi bhi aisi dawa ke ad pe ban lagata hai jo "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure" ke liye ho, yaani sexual pleasure ki capacity banaye rakhne ya badhane ke liye [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Pehli conviction pe chhe mahine tak jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Law purana hai; problem enforcement ki hai. 26 March 2025 ko, Indian Medical Association v. Union of India case mein, Supreme Court ne kaha ki "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit", yaani ye Act sahi maayne mein laagu hi nahi hua. Court ne states ko enforcement officers appoint karne ke liye ek mahina diya, aur public ke complaint karne ka tareeka, jaise toll-free number ya email, banane ke liye do mahine [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Iske baare mein apne state ke drug control ya health department se pucho.

Sabse bada nuksaan time ka hai. Capsules pe bitaya har mahina wo mahina hai jo un techniques aur counselling pe nahi laga jo sach mein farak laati hain, aur sharam ka ek aur badhta hua mahina.

## Partner se kaise baat karun, aur help kahan milegi?

Baat bedroom ke bahar karo, uske baad wale awkward minuton mein nahi. Batao ki kya ho raha hai, ki ye common hai aur iska ilaaj hai, aur ki tum iske liye kuch kar rahe ho. Partner se poocho ki unhe kya achha lagta hai: nazdeeki aur dhyaan bhi achhe sex ka hissa hain, sirf ye nahi ki kitni der chala. Sex sirf penetration nahi hai; touch, oral sex aur baari-baari se ek-doosre pe dhyaan dena dono ko bina ghadi dekhe enjoy karne deta hai.

Phir help lo:

- General physician, urologist ya psychiatrist confidentially tumhe check kar sakte hain. Signboard pe likha "sexologist" apne aap mein koi medical qualification nahi hai, isliye medical degree aur state medical council ka registration check karo.
- Agar iske peeche anxiety ya udaasi hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, ye Health Ministry ki free, 24 ghante chalne wali mental-health helpline hai jo October 2022 se chal rahi hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]] [[tele-manas]].

India mein jinhe mental health care chahiye, unmein se zyada tar use dhoondhte hi nahi. National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 ka estimate tha ki lagbhag 150 million Indians ko mental health care ki zaroorat thi, lekin 30 million se bhi kam ne ise dhoonda [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. PE jitni common problem pe baat karne ke liye himmat nahi chahiye honi chahiye. Bas ek imaandaar baat-cheet aur ek appointment chahiye.

preventable-infertility-chlamydia-pcos.en:
Most Indians meet the word "infertility" late: after the wedding, after a year or two of trying. By then some of the damage can be years old. An infection at 22 that never produced a symptom. Periods that came every few months since school and were called "normal for her". Pain every month that everyone promised marriage would cure.

The World Health Organization estimates that about 17.5% of adults, roughly 1 in 6, experience infertility in their lifetime [[who-infertility-estimates-2023]]. Much of that cannot be prevented, and none of it is anyone's fault. But some of its causes can be avoided, or caught early enough to protect fertility. This is about that part.

## Infertility's preventable causes

WHO's list of causes includes several that begin long before anyone is trying for a baby: fallopian tubes blocked by untreated sexually transmitted infections (STIs), unsafe abortion or infection after childbirth; ovarian disorders such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS); and conditions of the uterus such as endometriosis. In men, infection can block the tubes that carry semen. Smoking, heavy drinking and obesity affect both partners [[who-infertility]].

"Preventable" means two different things here. An infection can be avoided, or cured before it scars. PCOS and endometriosis have no cure, but found early they can be managed, instead of being discovered a decade later in a fertility clinic.

| Condition | Why it is missed | What protects fertility |
|---|---|---|
| Chlamydia, gonorrhoea | Often no symptoms | Condoms, testing, treatment for both partners |
| PCOS | Irregular periods treated as normal | Early diagnosis, long-term management |
| Endometriosis | Period pain dismissed | Early assessment and treatment |

## Silent STIs and damaged tubes

Chlamydia is a bacterial infection spread through sex, and it is curable with antibiotics. Its danger is its silence: many people have no symptoms, or only mild ones. Left untreated in women, it can cause pelvic inflammatory disease, chronic pelvic pain, ectopic pregnancy and infertility. In men it can cause a painful infection of the testicles [[who-chlamydia]]. Gonorrhoea is also curable, and WHO calls the two infections important causes of pelvic inflammatory disease and infertility in women [[who-sti]].

India's public system is not built to find a silent infection. The national AIDS programme managed about 1.12 crore cases of STIs and reproductive tract infections in 2024-25, including 71.95 lakh visits to its Suraksha Clinics, 60.9% of them by women [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Those are visits, not people, and care is largely "syndromic": the treatment is chosen from the symptoms a patient reports. WHO's verdict on that approach is that it misses infections without symptoms, and that laboratory tests for chlamydia and gonorrhoea are largely unavailable in low- and middle-income countries [[who-sti]].

Read the two facts together. The infections most able to damage the tubes are the ones least likely to send anyone to a clinic. "I have no symptoms" is not a test result.

When symptoms do appear, they deserve a doctor: unusual discharge, burning while urinating, bleeding between periods or after sex, or lower abdominal pain in women; discharge, burning or testicular pain in men. Partners need treatment too, or the infection returns [[who-chlamydia]]. An STI is an infection, not a character certificate.

## PCOS: common, under-diagnosed, manageable

WHO calls PCOS the most common cause of anovulation, meaning the ovaries do not release an egg, and a leading cause of infertility. It estimates that PCOS affects 10-13% of women of reproductive age worldwide, and that up to 70% of the women who have it do not know [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

India's numbers sit in the same range. An ICMR-funded national study of women aged 18-40 found PCOS in 7.2% by the strictest criteria and 19.6% by the broadest [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. At the upper end, that is close to one woman in five.

The signs are not hidden: periods that are irregular, unpredictable or absent, excess hair on the face or body, acne, thinning hair on the head [[who-pcos]]. They are missed because families treat them as cosmetic problems, or wait for marriage to "settle" the cycle. So the diagnosis often arrives only when a pregnancy does not.

There is no cure, but there is a great deal of treatment: healthy eating and physical activity, pills that regulate periods, medicines that stimulate ovulation when a woman wants to conceive, and IVF if needed. Pregnancy is possible with PCOS [[who-pcos]]. Knowing at 19 gives a woman years to manage it. Finding out at 32 does not.

## Endometriosis and years of 'normal' pain

In endometriosis, tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside it. WHO estimates that it affects 10% of women of reproductive age worldwide, about 190 million, and that diagnosis takes 4 to 12 years on average [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. That is a global estimate; we found no reliable national figure for India.

Those years are the problem. Severe period pain, pelvic pain that continues between periods and heavy bleeding are typical, and the disease is linked to infertility [[who-endometriosis]]. A girl told at 15 that every woman suffers like this can reach her late twenties with a disease that has had a decade to advance.

There is no cure, but WHO says early diagnosis and good care may slow or halt the disease, with treatment ranging from pain relief and hormonal medicines to surgery and, for those trying to conceive, fertility treatment [[who-endometriosis]].

## What to check, and when

None of this needs a fertility clinic. It needs ordinary care, earlier.

**If you are sexually active**, use condoms. Used correctly and consistently, they are the most effective way to prevent chlamydia [[who-chlamydia]]. Ask for an STI test if you have symptoms, a new partner, or a partner who has been diagnosed. NACO runs 1,127 Suraksha Clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]; a gynaecologist or dermatologist can also test and treat.

**If your periods regularly skip months**, or come with new facial hair or stubborn acne, ask a doctor to check for PCOS. **If period pain makes you miss college or work**, ask about endometriosis by name.

**If you are a man**, discharge, burning or testicular pain needs a doctor, not a home remedy or a quiet wait. An untreated infection can harm your partner's fertility as well as yours.

**If you have been trying for 12 months** without a pregnancy, go as a couple, so that both are examined [[who-infertility]].

You do not have to be married to see a gynaecologist, and a doctor who lectures you instead of examining you can be replaced. Early care is not a guarantee: some infertility stays unexplained however careful anyone is. It is a way of not losing years to silence.
preventable-infertility-chlamydia-pcos.hg:
Zyada tar Indians "infertility" shabd se der se milte hain: shaadi ke baad, ek-do saal koshish karne ke baad. Tab tak kuch nuksaan saalon purana ho chuka hota hai. 22 ki umar ka ek infection jisne kabhi koi symptom nahi diya. Woh periods jo school ke time se kuch-kuch mahinon mein aate the aur jinhe "iske liye toh normal hai" keh diya gaya. Har mahine ka woh dard jiske baare mein sabne vaada kiya tha ki shaadi ke baad theek ho jaayega.

World Health Organization ka estimate hai ki lagbhag 17.5% adults, yaani roughly 6 mein se 1, zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility face karte hain [[who-infertility-estimates-2023]]. Isme se bahut kuch roka nahi ja sakta, aur isme kisi ki galti nahi hoti. Lekin iski kuch wajahon se bacha ja sakta hai, ya unhe itni jaldi pakda ja sakta hai ki fertility bach jaaye. Yeh article usi hisse ke baare mein hai.

## Infertility ki woh wajahein jo roki ja sakti hain

WHO ki wajahon ki list mein kai aisi hain jo tab shuru hoti hain jab koi baby ke liye try bhi nahi kar raha hota: bina ilaaj ke sexually transmitted infections (STIs), unsafe abortion ya delivery ke baad ke infection se block hui fallopian tubes; ovaries ke disorders jaise polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS); aur uterus ki conditions jaise endometriosis. Mardon mein infection semen le jaane wali tubes ko block kar sakta hai. Smoking, zyada sharaab aur obesity dono partners par asar daalte hain [[who-infertility]].

Yahan "preventable" ke do alag matlab hain. Infection se bacha ja sakta hai, ya nuksaan hone se pehle use theek kiya ja sakta hai. PCOS aur endometriosis ka koi cure nahi hai, lekin jaldi pata chal jaaye toh inhe manage kiya ja sakta hai, bajaye iske ki das saal baad kisi fertility clinic mein pata chale.

| Condition | Kyun miss ho jaati hai | Fertility ko kya bachata hai |
|---|---|---|
| Chlamydia, gonorrhoea | Aksar koi symptom nahi | Condom, testing, dono partners ka ilaaj |
| PCOS | Irregular periods ko normal maan liya jaata hai | Jaldi diagnosis, lambe time ka management |
| Endometriosis | Period ke dard ko taal diya jaata hai | Jaldi jaanch aur ilaaj |

## Chupchaap rehne wale STIs aur damaged tubes

Chlamydia ek bacterial infection hai jo sex se failta hai, aur antibiotics se theek ho jaata hai. Iska khatra iski khamoshi hai: kai logon ko koi symptom nahi hota, ya bas halke se hote hain. Aurton mein bina ilaaj ke yeh pelvic inflammatory disease, lambe time tak chalne wala pelvic pain, ectopic pregnancy aur infertility kar sakta hai. Mardon mein isse testicles ka dardnaak infection ho sakta hai [[who-chlamydia]]. Gonorrhoea bhi theek ho sakta hai, aur WHO in dono infections ko aurton mein pelvic inflammatory disease aur infertility ki important wajah batata hai [[who-sti]].

India ka public system khamosh infection dhoondhne ke liye bana hi nahi hai. National AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein STIs aur reproductive tract infections ke lagbhag 1.12 crore cases manage kiye, jinmein uske Suraksha Clinics par 71.95 lakh visits shaamil hain, aur inmein se 60.9% visits aurton ki thi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh visits ki ginti hai, logon ki nahi, aur care zyada tar "syndromic" hai: ilaaj un symptoms ke hisaab se chuna jaata hai jo patient batata hai. Is tareeke par WHO ka apna faisla yeh hai ki isme bina symptoms wale infections chhoot jaate hain, aur low- aur middle-income deshon mein chlamydia aur gonorrhoea ke lab tests zyada tar available hi nahi hain [[who-sti]].

Ab in dono baaton ko saath padhiye. Jo infections tubes ko sabse zyada nuksaan pahuncha sakte hain, wahi kisi ko clinic bhejne ki sabse kam sambhavna rakhte hain. "Mujhe koi symptom nahi hai" koi test result nahi hai.

Jab symptoms dikhein, toh doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai: aurton mein ajeeb discharge, peshaab mein jalan, periods ke beech ya sex ke baad bleeding, ya pet ke nichle hisse mein dard; mardon mein discharge, jalan ya testicles mein dard. Partner ka bhi ilaaj zaroori hai, warna infection laut aata hai [[who-chlamydia]]. STI ek infection hai, character certificate nahi.

## PCOS: common, under-diagnosed, manageable

WHO ke mutabik PCOS anovulation ki sabse common wajah hai, yaani ovaries egg release nahi karti, aur infertility ki ek leading wajah bhi. Uska estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein reproductive age ki 10-13% aurton ko PCOS hai, aur jinhe yeh hai unmein se 70% tak ko pata hi nahi hota [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

India ke numbers bhi isi range mein hain. ICMR-funded ek national study mein 18-40 saal ki aurton mein PCOS sabse strict criteria se 7.2% mein mila aur sabse broad criteria se 19.6% mein [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Upar wali limit par yeh lagbhag har paanch mein se ek aurat hai.

Iske signs chhupe hue nahi hain: periods ka irregular, unpredictable ya gaayab hona, chehre ya shareer par zyada baal, acne, sir ke baalon ka patla hona [[who-pcos]]. Yeh miss isliye hote hain kyunki families inhe cosmetic problem maan leti hain, ya intezaar karti hain ki shaadi ke baad cycle "set" ho jaayega. Isliye diagnosis aksar tab aata hai jab pregnancy nahi aati.

Iska koi cure nahi hai, lekin ilaaj bahut hai: healthy khaana aur physical activity, periods regular karne wali pills, jab aurat conceive karna chahe tab ovulation stimulate karne wali dawaiyan, aur zaroorat pade toh IVF. PCOS ke saath pregnancy possible hai [[who-pcos]]. 19 ki umar mein pata chal jaaye toh ise manage karne ke liye saalon ka time milta hai. 32 mein pata chale toh nahi milta.

## Endometriosis aur 'normal' dard ke kai saal

Endometriosis mein uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar ugne lagta hai. WHO ka estimate hai ki yeh duniya bhar mein reproductive age ki 10% aurton ko hota hai, yaani lagbhag 190 million ko, aur iska diagnosis hone mein average 4 se 12 saal lagte hain [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. Yeh global estimate hai; India ke liye humein koi bharosemand national figure nahi mila.

Problem yahi saal hain. Periods mein bahut tez dard, periods ke beech bhi chalne wala pelvic pain aur heavy bleeding iske typical signs hain, aur yeh bimaari infertility se judi hai [[who-endometriosis]]. Jis ladki ko 15 ki umar mein bata diya jaaye ki har aurat aise hi sehti hai, woh apne late twenties tak ek aisi bimaari ke saath pahunch sakti hai jise badhne ke liye poora ek dashak mil chuka hai.

Iska bhi cure nahi hai, lekin WHO kehta hai ki jaldi diagnosis aur achchi care is bimaari ko dheema kar sakti hai ya rok sakti hai, aur ilaaj mein pain relief aur hormonal dawaiyon se lekar surgery tak, aur conceive karne ki koshish kar rahe logon ke liye fertility treatment tak shaamil hai [[who-endometriosis]].

## Kya check karwana hai, aur kab

Iske liye fertility clinic ki zaroorat nahi hai. Zaroorat hai aam care ki, thoda pehle.

**Agar aap sexually active hain**, toh condom use kijiye. Sahi tareeke se aur har baar use kiya jaaye, toh yeh chlamydia se bachne ka sabse effective tareeka hai [[who-chlamydia]]. Agar symptoms hon, naya partner ho, ya partner ko STI nikla ho, toh STI test maangiye. NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Suraksha Clinics chalata hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]; gynaecologist ya dermatologist bhi test aur ilaaj kar sakte hain.

**Agar aapke periods baar-baar mahinon tak skip hote hain**, ya saath mein chehre par naye baal ya ziddi acne hai, toh doctor se PCOS check karne ko kahiye. **Agar period ke dard ki wajah se college ya kaam chhoot jaata hai**, toh naam lekar endometriosis ke baare mein poochiye.

**Agar aap mard hain**, toh discharge, jalan ya testicles mein dard ho toh gharelu nuskhe ya chup-chaap intezaar ke bajaye doctor ko dikhaiye. Bina ilaaj ka infection aapki hi nahi, aapke partner ki fertility ko bhi nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai.

**Agar aap 12 mahine se try kar rahe hain** aur pregnancy nahi hui, toh couple ki tarah jaiye, taaki dono ki jaanch ho [[who-infertility]].

Gynaecologist ke paas jaane ke liye shaadishuda hona zaroori nahi, aur jo doctor jaanch karne ke bajaye lecture de, use badla ja sakta hai. Jaldi care koi guarantee nahi hai: kuch infertility ki wajah kabhi pata nahi chalti, chaahe koi kitna bhi dhyaan rakhe. Yeh bas ek tareeka hai ki khamoshi mein saal na gawaye jaayein.

sex-questions-ai-chatbots-influencers-fa.en:
Picture a 19-year-old in Patna who had sex without a condom last night. She will not ask her mother, and the nearest clinic feels too public. So she types the question into a chatbot, and then scrolls Instagram, where a man in a white coat with no visible degree is selling a "natural" fix for everything. For many young people this is what sex education looks like now: private, instant, and with no guarantee that the answer is right. The research and rules of 2025 tell us how far to trust each source.

## How often do chatbots get sexual health right?

In 2025 researchers in Melbourne tested AI chatbots on 195 real, anonymised questions people had asked a sexual-health clinic's phone line. A panel of experts, reviewing the answers in blinded order, judged a specially tuned clinic chatbot correct 85.2% of the time, a second tuned chatbot 69.3%, and standard ChatGPT 64.8%. All the chatbots scored best on safety, meaning they rarely gave dangerous advice, but the authors concluded that every one of them could produce incorrect information and that they need human oversight [[bmc-chatbots-sexual-health-2025]].

Read that the other way round: even the best system was not judged correct on about one answer in seven (14.8%), and the general-purpose chatbot most people use on a little over one in three (35.2%). Part of that gap came from clinic-specific questions, such as opening hours, that a general chatbot cannot know; all three did better on general sexual-health questions. The questions were from adults in Australia, not Indian teenagers, and chatbots change quickly, so treat this as a warning about the method rather than a score that holds forever.

Teenagers are already relying on these tools for more than facts. A 2025 US survey found that about one in three teen users of AI companions had discussed something important or serious with an AI instead of a real person [[commonsense-ai-companions-2025]]. Some companies now offer teen settings; OpenAI's parental controls, launched in September 2025, reduce sexual and romantic role-play for linked teen accounts [[openai-parental-controls-2025]]. A content filter is not the same as a correct medical answer.

> A chatbot can help you find the right question. It cannot examine you, test you, or notice that something is wrong.

## The influencer problem, and the rules that exist

Since August 2023 India's advertising self-regulator, ASCI, has required influencers who advise on or promote health and nutrition products or services, including claims about preventing, treating or curing medical conditions, to hold a relevant qualification, such as a medical degree or certification as a nurse, nutritionist, dietician, physiotherapist or psychologist, and to show it prominently and upfront in the post or as the opening remark in a video [[asci-influencer-guidelines-2025]]. The rule covers content tied to commercial products and services, and unqualified influencers may still share general, non-technical information; ASCI is a self-regulator, not a court, but its guidelines give you a test: no qualification shown on a sponsored health claim is a red flag.

The older law is stricter. The Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 bans advertising any drug for "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure", for preventing conception, or for correcting menstrual disorders, and bans ads claiming to cure diseases on its schedule, including venereal diseases [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. A first conviction can bring up to six months in jail. In March 2025 the Supreme Court said the Act had "no implementation" in its true spirit and ordered states to appoint enforcement officers and set up complaint channels [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

## A five-step check for any sex-ed answer

1. **Who is speaking?** A named doctor, a government clinic or WHO, or an anonymous account or bot?
2. **Is something being sold?** A product link next to health advice is a conflict of interest.
3. **Does it promise a cure for "weakness", size or performance?** In India, advertising that is illegal.
4. **Does it match a trusted source?** For example, emergency contraception works best as early as possible and can be used up to 5 days (120 hours) after unprotected sex; it is not an abortion and does not protect against STIs [[who-ec]].
5. **Is time critical?** HIV post-exposure medicine (PEP) must be started as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure, after a clinician's assessment [[who-pep]]. That is a clinic visit, not a chat.

India's Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics, run under the national adolescent health programme, exist so that young people can ask these questions in confidence [[nhm-afhc]]. Use the chatbot to prepare your questions. Then ask a person who is accountable for the answer.
sex-questions-ai-chatbots-influencers-fa.hg:
Sochiye, Patna ki ek 19 saal ki ladki ne kal raat bina condom ke sex kiya. Woh maa se nahi poochegi, aur paas ka clinic use bahut public lagta hai. To woh sawaal chatbot mein type karti hai, aur phir Instagram scroll karti hai, jahan safed coat mein ek aadmi, jiski koi degree dikh nahi rahi, har cheez ka "natural" ilaaj bech raha hai. Bahut se young logon ke liye aaj sex education aisi hi dikhti hai: private, turant, aur bina kisi guarantee ke ki jawab sahi hai. 2025 ki research aur rules bataate hain ki kis source par kitna bharosa karein.

## Chatbots sexual health mein kitni baar sahi hote hain?

2025 mein Melbourne ke researchers ne AI chatbots ko 195 asli, bina naam ke sawaalon par test kiya jo logon ne ek sexual-health clinic ki phone line par poochhe the. Experts ke ek panel ne, jawaabon ko blinded order mein dekhte hue, ek khaas-tuned clinic chatbot ko 85.2% baar sahi maana, doosre tuned chatbot ko 69.3%, aur standard ChatGPT ko 64.8%. Sabhi chatbots ne safety par sabse achha kiya, yaani khatarnaak salaah kam di, lekin authors ka nateeja tha ki har ek galat jaankari de sakta hai aur unhe insaani nigrani chahiye [[bmc-chatbots-sexual-health-2025]].

Ise ulta padhiye: sabse achha system bhi lagbhag har saat mein se ek jawab (14.8%) par sahi nahi maana gaya, aur jo general chatbot zyada tar log use karte hain, woh har teen mein se ek se thoda zyada (35.2%) par. Is fark ka ek hissa clinic se jude sawaalon, jaise clinic kab khulta hai, se aaya, jo general chatbot jaan hi nahi sakta; teenon ne general sexual-health sawaalon par behtar kiya. Sawaal Australia ke adults ke the, Indian teenagers ke nahi, aur chatbots tezi se badalte hain, isliye ise hamesha ke score ke bajaye tareeke ki chetavani samjhiye.

Teenagers in tools par sirf facts ke liye nahi tike. 2025 ke ek US survey mein paaya gaya ki AI companions use karne wale lagbhag har teen mein se ek teenager ne koi zaroori ya gambhir baat insaan ke bajaye AI se ki thi [[commonsense-ai-companions-2025]]. Kuch companies ab teen settings deti hain; September 2025 mein launch hue OpenAI ke parental controls linked teen accounts ke liye sexual aur romantic role-play kam karte hain [[openai-parental-controls-2025]]. Content filter sahi medical jawab ke barabar nahi hai.

> Chatbot sahi sawaal dhoondhne mein madad kar sakta hai. Woh aapki jaanch nahi kar sakta, test nahi kar sakta, aur yeh nahi dekh sakta ki kuch gadbad hai.

## Influencer ki samasya, aur jo rules hain

August 2023 se India ki advertising self-regulator ASCI ne zaroori kiya hai ki jo influencers health aur nutrition products ya services par salaah dete ya unhe promote karte hain, jismein kisi medical condition ko rokne, theek karne ya ilaaj ke daave bhi shaamil hain, unke paas sambandhit qualification ho, jaise medical degree ya nurse, nutritionist, dietician, physiotherapist ya psychologist ka certification, aur woh ise post mein shuru mein saaf-saaf ya video ki pehli baat ke roop mein bataayein [[asci-influencer-guidelines-2025]]. Yeh rule commercial products aur services se jude content par laagu hota hai, aur bina qualification wale influencers aam, non-technical jaankari share kar sakte hain; ASCI self-regulator hai, court nahi, lekin iski guidelines ek test deti hain: sponsored health claim par qualification na dikhe to yeh khatre ka sanket hai.

Purana law aur sakht hai. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 "the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure", garbh rokne, ya menstrual disorders theek karne ke liye kisi bhi dawa ka ad dene par rok lagaata hai, aur apni schedule ki bimaariyon, jinmein venereal diseases bhi hain, ke ilaaj ka daava karne wale ads par bhi [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Pehli baar doshi paaye jaane par chhe mahine tak ki jail ho sakti hai. March 2025 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki is Act ka asli bhaav mein "no implementation" hai, aur states ko enforcement officers niyukt karne aur complaint ke raaste banaane ka order diya [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

## Kisi bhi sex-ed jawab ke liye paanch kadam ki jaanch

1. **Bol kaun raha hai?** Naam wala doctor, sarkari clinic ya WHO, ya koi anjaan account ya bot?
2. **Kya kuch bech raha hai?** Health salaah ke saath product link hitoon ka takraav hai.
3. **Kya "kamzori", size ya performance ke ilaaj ka vaada hai?** India mein aisa ad gair-kaanooni hai.
4. **Kya yeh kisi bharosemand source se milta hai?** Jaise, emergency contraception jitni jaldi ho utni behtar kaam karti hai aur bina protection ke sex ke 5 din (120 ghante) tak li ja sakti hai; yeh abortion nahi hai aur STIs se nahi bachaati [[who-ec]].
5. **Kya samay bahut zaroori hai?** HIV post-exposure dawa (PEP) clinician ki jaanch ke baad jitni jaldi ho sake aur exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye [[who-pep]]. Yeh clinic ka kaam hai, chat ka nahi.

India ke Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics, jo national adolescent health programme ke tahat chalte hain, isiliye hain ki young log yeh sawaal bharose ke saath pooch sakein [[nhm-afhc]]. Apne sawaal taiyaar karne ke liye chatbot use kariye. Phir us insaan se poochiye jo jawab ke liye zimmedar hai.

sti-myths-regular-partner-symptoms.en:
The myths about sexually transmitted infections (STIs) that do the most damage are not the frightening ones. They are the comforting ones, and each ends in the same conclusion: you do not need a test. Four are common in India. An infection shows. It happens to other kinds of people. Washing takes care of it. One treatment settles it for life.

The government's own figures disagree. India's AIDS programme managed about 1.12 crore (111.8 lakh) STI/RTI cases in 2024-25 [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Myth: you can tell by looking

The World Health Organization (WHO) says STIs are often asymptomatic, and that the majority of the curable STIs acquired worldwide cause no symptoms [[who-sti]]. A person can look healthy, feel healthy, be educated, well dressed and "from a good family", and carry an infection for years.

Syphilis shows how this works. Its first sign is usually a painless sore that heals by itself while the infection stays in the body [[who-syphilis]]. It is found by a blood test, not by looking. Of 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings at India's government STI clinics in 2024-25, 43,482 (0.94%) were reactive [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. In the same year India identified 10,545 pregnant women with syphilis [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Only 77% of pregnant women were tested for it at all, so roughly one in four was not tested [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

People who come to an STI clinic are not a sample of all Indians, so 0.94% is not a national infection rate. What the figure does show is tens of thousands of reactive results that turned up only because someone ran a test.

## Myth: only people with many partners get infected

Risk does rise with more partners. But one exposure is enough, and your risk depends on your partner's history as much as on your own.

Among 1,63,306 people newly diagnosed with HIV in India in 2024-25, 26.5% reported sex with a regular partner as the route, against 32.1% who reported casual partners and 15.1% commercial partners [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. "Regular partner" is the category in which a husband, wife or steady partner falls. These answers are self-reported at diagnosis, and stigma hides some routes. Even so, more than a quarter of the newly diagnosed pointed to a steady relationship.

A second number points the same way. In 2024-25, 6.6 lakh spouses, partners and children of people living with HIV were tested through NACO's index testing service. Of them, 4.1% tested positive, about ten times the 0.40% positivity among all at-risk people tested that year [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

> An undiagnosed infection puts the person closest to it at the greatest risk.

Imagine a 27-year-old woman in Nagpur who has had one partner in her life, her husband. Her first HIV and syphilis tests come during pregnancy. If one is reactive, the myth has its verdict ready: she must have "done something". The evidence says otherwise. An infection can stay silent for months or years, so a diagnosis cannot show who had it first, and it is not proof that anyone cheated.

Sex is not the only route either. In the same HIV data, 11.5% of the newly diagnosed reported shared needles or syringes, and 3.5% were infected from mother to child [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. People also get STIs through sexual abuse. None of this is a measure of character.

## Myth: washing or urinating after sex prevents STIs

Washing the genitals, urinating or douching after sex feels like doing something. It is not a recognised way to prevent STIs. WHO's fact sheet on STIs names condoms and vaccines as protection; no washing routine appears in it [[who-sti]].

After a possible exposure to HIV, what works is medical and has a deadline. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) has to start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure, and it is taken for 28 days [[who-pep]].

## Myth: treated once, immune for life

Many people assume that once an STI is treated, the body is protected from it. Curable STIs do not work like that. Being cured of chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis or trichomoniasis leaves no lasting immunity. A person can be infected again straight away, often by a partner who was never treated.

That is why WHO calls treating sexual partners an important part of STI care, to interrupt transmission and prevent re-infection [[who-sti]]. "Cured" also has limits. The bacterial STIs are curable; for viral ones such as HIV and herpes, medicines control the infection but do not remove it [[who-sti]].

NACO's 111.8 lakh figure also counts episodes, not people, so one person can appear in it more than once [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## What actually protects you

- Condoms, used correctly and every time, are among the most effective protection against STIs, including HIV. They protect less fully against infections that spread from sores on skin a condom does not cover, such as syphilis and genital herpes [[who-sti]].
- Vaccines exist for two viral STIs, HPV and hepatitis B [[who-sti]].
- A test is the only way to know. Sensible moments are a new partner, before a couple stops using condoms, pregnancy, a partner's diagnosis, or any sore, discharge or burning. NACO runs 1,127 Suraksha Clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- If you are treated, finish the treatment and make sure your partner is treated too.
- NACO's helpline 1097 offers confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

If you are under 18, the law treats sexual activity with you as an offence whatever the "consent", and anyone who knows of such an offence, a doctor included, must report it to the police [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. So a doctor cannot promise complete secrecy. Go anyway: your health comes first, and the Child Helpline 1098 can help.

Each of the four myths gives you a reason to skip the test. The data gives you the reasons to take it.
sti-myths-regular-partner-symptoms.hg:
Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) ke baare mein sabse zyada nuksaan wo myths nahi karte jo darate hain. Nuksaan wo karte hain jo tasalli dete hain, aur har ek ka nateeja ek hi hota hai: tumhe test ki zaroorat nahi. India mein aise chaar myths aam hain. Infection dikh jaata hai. Ye doosri tarah ke logon ko hota hai. Dho lene se kaam ho jaata hai. Ek baar ilaaj ho gaya toh zindagi bhar ki chhutti.

Sarkaar ke apne figures kuch aur kehte hain. India ke AIDS programme ne 2024-25 mein lagbhag 1.12 crore (111.8 lakh) STI/RTI cases manage kiye [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Myth: dekh ke pata chal jaata hai

World Health Organization (WHO) kehta hai ki STIs mein aksar koi symptom hota hi nahi, aur duniya bhar mein jo curable STIs hote hain unmein se zyada tar bina symptoms ke hote hain [[who-sti]]. Koi insaan healthy dikh sakta hai, healthy mehsoos kar sakta hai, padha-likha, achchhe kapdon wala aur "achchhe ghar ka" ho sakta hai, aur phir bhi saalon tak ek infection le ke ghoom sakta hai.

Syphilis se samjho ki ye kaise hota hai. Iska pehla sign aksar ek aisa zakhm hota hai jisme dard nahi hota aur jo apne aap bhar jaata hai, jabki infection body mein bana rehta hai [[who-syphilis]]. Ye blood test se pakda jaata hai, dekhne se nahi. 2024-25 mein India ke sarkaari STI clinics mein 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings hui, jinmein se 43,482 (0.94%) reactive aayi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Usi saal India ne 10,545 pregnant women mein syphilis ki pehchaan ki [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Pregnant women mein se sirf 77% ka hi syphilis test hua, yaani lagbhag har chaar mein se ek ka test nahi hua [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

STI clinic aane wale log saare Indians ka sample nahi hain, isliye 0.94% koi national infection rate nahi hai. Ye figure itna zaroor dikhata hai ki dason hazaar reactive results sirf isliye saamne aaye kyunki kisi ne test kiya.

## Myth: infection sirf unhe hota hai jinke bahut partners hon

Zyada partners se risk badhta zaroor hai. Lekin ek exposure kaafi hai, aur tumhara risk jitna tumhari history pe depend karta hai utna hi tumhare partner ki history pe bhi.

2024-25 mein India mein jin 1,63,306 logon ko HIV ka naya diagnosis hua, unmein se 26.5% ne regular partner ke saath sex ko route bataya, jabki 32.1% ne casual partners aur 15.1% ne commercial partners bataye [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. "Regular partner" wo category hai jisme pati, patni ya steady partner aate hain. Ye jawaab diagnosis ke waqt log khud dete hain, aur stigma kuch routes ko chhupa deta hai. Phir bhi, naye diagnosis wale logon mein se ek chauthai se zyada ne ek steady rishte ki taraf ishaara kiya.

Ek doosra number bhi yahi kehta hai. 2024-25 mein NACO ki index testing service ke through HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke 6.6 lakh spouses, partners aur bachchon ka test hua. Unmein se 4.1% positive nikle, jo us saal test hue saare at-risk logon ki 0.40% positivity ka lagbhag das guna hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

> Jis infection ka diagnosis nahi hua, uska sabse bada khatra usi insaan ko hota hai jo uske sabse kareeb hai.

Socho, Nagpur mein 27 saal ki ek woman hai jiski zindagi mein ek hi partner raha hai, uska pati. Uske pehle HIV aur syphilis tests pregnancy ke dauraan hote hain. Agar ek reactive aata hai, toh myth ke paas faisla pehle se taiyaar hai: usne zaroor "kuch kiya hoga". Evidence kuch aur kehta hai. Infection mahinon ya saalon tak chup reh sakta hai, isliye diagnosis ye nahi bata sakta ki pehle kise tha, aur ye is baat ka saboot nahi hai ki kisi ne cheat kiya.

Sex akela route bhi nahi hai. Usi HIV data mein naye diagnosis wale 11.5% logon ne shared needles ya syringes bataye, aur 3.5% ko infection maa se bachche mein aaya [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Logon ko STIs sexual abuse se bhi hote hain. Inmein se kuch bhi kisi ke character ka naap nahi hai.

## Myth: sex ke baad dhone ya peshaab karne se STIs nahi hote

Sex ke baad genitals dhona, peshaab karna ya douching karna aisa lagta hai jaise kuch kar liya. Lekin ye STIs se bachne ka koi maana hua tareeka nahi hai. WHO ki STIs wali fact sheet protection ke liye condoms aur vaccines ka naam leti hai; usme dhone ka koi routine kahin nahi hai [[who-sti]].

HIV ke possible exposure ke baad jo cheez kaam karti hai wo medical hai, aur uski deadline hai. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) jitni jaldi ho sake shuru karna hota hai, exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar hi, aur ise 28 din tak lena hota hai [[who-pep]].

## Myth: ek baar ilaaj ho gaya toh zindagi bhar immune

Bahut log maan lete hain ki ek baar STI ka ilaaj ho gaya toh body us se protected ho gayi. Curable STIs aise kaam nahi karte. Chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis ya trichomoniasis theek ho jaane ke baad koi lasting immunity nahi bachti. Insaan turant dobara infect ho sakta hai, aksar us partner se jiska ilaaj kabhi hua hi nahi.

Isiliye WHO sexual partners ke ilaaj ko STI care ka ek zaroori hissa kehta hai, taaki transmission ruke aur re-infection na ho [[who-sti]]. "Theek ho gaya" ki bhi ek limit hai. Bacterial STIs theek ho sakte hain; HIV aur herpes jaise viral STIs mein dawaein infection ko control karti hain, khatam nahi karti [[who-sti]].

NACO ka 111.8 lakh wala figure bhi episodes ginta hai, log nahi, yaani ek hi insaan usme ek se zyada baar aa sakta hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Asal mein kya bachata hai

- Condoms, sahi tareeke se aur har baar use kiye jaayein, toh STIs aur HIV se bachaav ke sabse effective tareekon mein se hain. Jo infections aisi skin ke zakhmon se failte hain jise condom cover nahi karta, jaise syphilis aur genital herpes, unse ye poora bachaav nahi dete [[who-sti]].
- Do viral STIs ke liye vaccines hain, HPV aur hepatitis B [[who-sti]].
- Pata karne ka ek hi tareeka hai, test. Test ke sahi mauke hain: naya partner, couple ke condom chhodne se pehle, pregnancy, partner ka diagnosis, ya koi bhi zakhm, discharge ya jalan. NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Suraksha Clinics chalata hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
- Agar tumhara ilaaj ho raha hai, toh use poora karo aur pakka karo ki tumhare partner ka ilaaj bhi ho.
- NACO ki helpline 1097 pe 16 bhashaon mein 24 ghante confidential counselling milti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh law tumhare saath hui sexual activity ko offence maanta hai, "consent" ho ya na ho, aur jise bhi aise offence ka pata ho, doctor samet, use police ko report karna hota hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Isliye doctor poori secrecy ka waada nahi kar sakta. Phir bhi jao: tumhari sehat pehle aati hai, aur Child Helpline 1098 madad kar sakti hai.

Chaaron myths tumhe test na karane ki ek wajah dete hain. Data test karane ki wajah deta hai.

sti-testing-guide-suraksha-clinics.en:
Most people decide whether they have a sexually transmitted infection by checking how they feel. It is the wrong test. The majority of STIs cause no symptoms, and only a test can tell [[who-sti]]. India's public system has the clinics: 1,127 Designated STI/RTI Clinics, branded Suraksha Clinics, at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. What it does not do is come looking for people who feel fine. This guide to getting tested anyway is general information, not medical or legal advice, and not a substitute for a doctor.

## Why "I feel fine" proves nothing

Chlamydia often causes no symptoms, and untreated it can lead to pelvic infection, ectopic pregnancy and infertility [[who-chlamydia]]. The first sore of syphilis is usually painless and heals by itself while the infection stays [[who-syphilis]]. HIV can go unnoticed for years [[who-hiv]].

India's programme managed about 1.12 crore STI/RTI cases in 2024-25, including 71.95 lakh visits at Suraksha Clinics [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Most of that care follows the syndromic approach: treatment based on the symptoms a person reports. WHO says the method is simple and allows same-day treatment, but misses infections, because most STIs have no symptoms [[who-sti]].

The system is built for people who arrive with a complaint. If you have a risk but no complaint, you have to ask for the test yourself.

## When to get tested

How often to test is a decision to make with a clinician. Common reasons to go:

- a new partner, or before you stop using condoms together;
- a condom that broke or slipped, or sex without one;
- a partner's positive test for any STI;
- pregnancy, or planning one;
- any symptom: a sore, unusual discharge, burning when you urinate, a rash, pain in the lower abdomen or a testicle;
- sexual assault: go to a hospital at once.

Some of these come with a clock. After a possible HIV exposure, PEP must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours, and is taken for 28 days [[who-pep]]. Ask for it before any test.

Your own sense of risk counts. In 2024-25, people who walked in on their own made up only 14% of the programme's 4.13 crore HIV tests among at-risk clients, yet had the highest positivity: 1.1%, against 0.40% overall [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## What to ask for: blood, urine and swab tests

No single test covers every STI. Which samples are taken depends on the infection and on the kind of sex you have had, so answer the clinician's questions honestly.

| Infection | Usual sample |
