|---|---|
| HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B | Blood |
| Chlamydia, gonorrhoea | Urine, or a swab from the genitals, throat or rectum |
| Sores or warts | Examination by the clinician |

Not every clinic can test for everything. Rapid, inexpensive tests exist for HIV and syphilis, but the accurate laboratory tests for chlamydia and gonorrhoea are largely unavailable in low- and middle-income countries [[who-sti]]. Syphilis testing is routine: Suraksha Clinics ran 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings in 2024-25, and 0.94% were reactive [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Ask which tests the clinic runs and, if it cannot test for chlamydia and gonorrhoea, whether a referral or a private laboratory makes sense.

Every infection has a window period, the gap between exposure and the point when a test can detect it [[who-hiv]]. It differs by infection and by test, so ask the clinician when your result will be reliable and whether you need a repeat test. Imagine a 23-year-old in Pune whose condom slipped on Saturday night. A test on Monday will come back negative whatever happened; it is too early.

## Suraksha Clinics and walk-in testing

At a district hospital or medical college, ask at registration for the STI clinic or the Suraksha Clinic. You can say: "I want to be tested for STIs, including HIV and syphilis." NACO's toll-free helpline, 1097 [[naco]], offers confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Expect questions about symptoms, partners and condoms, perhaps an examination, and a blood sample. For HIV the law is explicit: under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017, no HIV test can be done without your informed consent (Section 5), and no one can be compelled to disclose their HIV status except by court order (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. If being seen worries you, use a hospital in another part of the city.

Women make 60.9% of the visits to these clinics [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Men, transgender people and men whose partners are men have the same claim on them. Telling the clinician what kind of sex you have gets you the right tests.

If you are under 18, go anyway, but know the limit. Sexual activity with anyone under 18 is an offence under POCSO whatever the "consent", and anyone who knows of such an offence, a doctor included, must report it to the police [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. So a doctor cannot promise a minor total secrecy; the rule exists to protect you. If someone is hurting you, the Child Helpline is 1098.

## After the result: treatment, retesting and partners

A negative result inside the window period means "not detected yet". Ask when to repeat it, and use condoms until then. Condoms greatly reduce the risk of STIs but do not remove it [[who-sti]].

A positive result for chlamydia, gonorrhoea or syphilis means a curable infection [[who-sti]]. Take the full course even if you feel better, and avoid sex until the clinician says the infection has cleared. Do not use leftover antibiotics or a chemist's guess: the wrong drug can hide symptoms without curing anything. A reactive HIV test is confirmed with further tests, and with treatment people with HIV can lead long and healthy lives [[who-hiv]].

Then the hard part: partners. A cure gives no immunity, so an untreated partner passes the infection back. That is why treating partners is part of treating you [[who-sti]]. Say: "I tested positive for chlamydia. It is curable. You need to get checked too." An infection does not prove cheating; many stay silent for months or years. If telling a partner feels unsafe, ask the clinic counsellor for help, and if you are threatened, call 112 or the Women Helpline.

Feeling fine is not a result. A test is.
sti-testing-guide-suraksha-clinics.hg:
Zyada tar log yeh dekh kar tay karte hain ki unhe sexually transmitted infection hai ya nahi, ki woh kaisa feel kar rahe hain. Yeh galat test hai. Zyada tar STIs ke koi symptoms nahi hote, aur sirf test se pata chalta hai [[who-sti]]. India ke public system ke paas clinics hain: 1,127 Designated STI/RTI Clinics, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kehte hain, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Jo yeh system nahi karta, woh hai un logon ko dhoondhna jo theek feel kar rahe hain. Phir bhi test kaise karwana hai, yeh guide usi ke liye hai. Yeh general information hai, medical ya legal advice nahi, aur doctor ka substitute nahi.

## "Main theek feel kar raha hoon" kuch saabit nahi karta

Chlamydia ke aksar koi symptoms nahi hote, aur ilaaj na ho toh isse pelvic infection, ectopic pregnancy aur infertility ho sakti hai [[who-chlamydia]]. Syphilis ka pehla ghaav usually painless hota hai aur apne aap bhar jaata hai, jabki infection body mein rehta hai [[who-syphilis]]. HIV saalon tak bina pata chale reh sakta hai [[who-hiv]].

India ke programme ne 2024-25 mein lagbhag 1.12 crore STI/RTI cases sambhale, jinmein Suraksha Clinics ki 71.95 lakh visits shaamil hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Is care ka zyada tar hissa syndromic approach par chalta hai: ilaaj un symptoms ke hisaab se hota hai jo insaan batata hai. WHO kehta hai ki yeh tareeka simple hai aur usi din treatment de deta hai, lekin infections chhoot jaate hain, kyunki zyada tar STIs ke symptoms hote hi nahi [[who-sti]].

System un logon ke liye bana hai jo koi takleef lekar aate hain. Agar tumhe risk hai lekin koi takleef nahi, toh test tumhe khud maangna padega.

## Test kab karwana chahiye

Kitni baar test karwana hai, yeh clinician ke saath milkar tay karne wali baat hai. Jaane ki common wajahein:

- naya partner, ya jab tum dono condom use karna band karne wale ho;
- condom phat gaya ya slip ho gaya, ya bina condom ke sex hua;
- partner ka kisi bhi STI ka test positive aaya;
- pregnancy, ya pregnancy ki planning;
- koi bhi symptom: ghaav, ajeeb discharge, peshab mein jalan, rash, pet ke nichle hisse ya testicle mein dard;
- sexual assault: turant hospital jao.

Inmein se kuch ke saath ghadi chal rahi hoti hai. HIV ke possible exposure ke baad PEP jitni jaldi ho sake shuru honi chahiye, 72 ghanton ke andar hi, aur yeh 28 din tak li jaati hai [[who-pep]]. Kisi bhi test se pehle PEP maango.

Risk ke baare mein tumhara apna andaaza maayne rakhta hai. 2024-25 mein programme ne at-risk clients ke 4.13 crore HIV tests kiye; jo log khud chal kar aaye, woh in tests ka sirf 14% the, phir bhi positivity sabse zyada unhi ki thi: 1.1%, jabki overall 0.40% [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Kya maangna hai: blood, urine aur swab tests

Koi ek test har STI ko cover nahi karta. Kaun se samples liye jaayenge, yeh infection par aur is par depend karta hai ki tumne kis tarah ka sex kiya hai, isliye clinician ke sawaalon ke jawab sach-sach do.

| Infection | Usual sample |
|---|---|
| HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B | Blood |
| Chlamydia, gonorrhoea | Urine, ya genitals, gale ya rectum ka swab |
| Ghaav ya warts | Clinician ki jaanch |

Har clinic har cheez ka test nahi kar sakta. HIV aur syphilis ke liye rapid aur saste tests maujood hain, lekin chlamydia aur gonorrhoea ke accurate laboratory tests low- aur middle-income countries mein zyada tar available hi nahi hain [[who-sti]]. Syphilis testing routine hai: Suraksha Clinics ne 2024-25 mein 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings ki, aur 0.94% reactive aayi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Poocho ki clinic kaun se tests karta hai, aur agar chlamydia aur gonorrhoea ka test wahan nahi hota, toh poocho ki referral ya private laboratory sense banati hai ya nahi.

Har infection ka ek window period hota hai, yaani exposure aur us point ke beech ka gap jab test use pakad sakta hai [[who-hiv]]. Yeh har infection aur har test ke liye alag hota hai, isliye clinician se poocho ki tumhara result kab reliable hoga aur dobara test chahiye ya nahi. Socho Pune ka ek 23 saal ka ladka, jiska condom Saturday raat ko slip ho gaya. Monday ka test negative hi aayega, chahe kuch bhi hua ho; abhi bahut jaldi hai.

## Suraksha Clinics aur walk-in testing

District hospital ya medical college mein registration par STI clinic ya Suraksha Clinic poocho. Tum keh sakte ho: "Mujhe STIs ka test karwana hai, HIV aur syphilis ke saath." NACO ki toll-free helpline 1097 [[naco]] din-raat 16 languages mein confidential counselling deti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Symptoms, partners aur condoms ke baare mein sawaal honge, shayad ek examination hoga, aur blood sample liya jaayega. HIV ke liye law saaf hai: HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 ke tahat tumhari informed consent ke bina koi HIV test nahi ho sakta (Section 5), aur court order ke bina kisi ko apna HIV status batane ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Agar kisi ke dekh lene ka darr hai, toh sheher ke kisi doosre hisse ka hospital chun lo.

In clinics ki 60.9% visits women ki hoti hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Men, transgender log aur woh men jinke partners men hain, in clinics par unka bhi utna hi haq hai. Clinician ko batao ki tum kis tarah ka sex karte ho, tabhi sahi tests honge.

Agar tum 18 se kam ho, tab bhi jao, lekin ek limit jaan lo. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sexual activity POCSO ke tahat offence hai, "consent" ho ya na ho, aur jise bhi aise offence ka pata ho, doctor samet, use police ko report karna hi hota hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Isliye doctor kisi minor se poori secrecy ka waada nahi kar sakta; yeh rule tumhari hifazat ke liye hai. Agar koi tumhe nuksaan pahuncha raha hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 hai.

## Result ke baad: treatment, dobara test aur partners

Window period ke andar aaya negative result ka matlab hai "abhi tak detect nahi hua". Poocho ki dobara kab karwana hai, aur tab tak condom use karo. Condoms STIs ka risk kaafi kam karte hain, lekin poora khatam nahi karte [[who-sti]].

Chlamydia, gonorrhoea ya syphilis ka positive result matlab ek curable infection [[who-sti]]. Poora course lo, chahe pehle hi better feel hone lage, aur jab tak clinician na keh de ki infection clear ho gaya hai, sex mat karo. Bachi hui antibiotics ya chemist ke andaaze par mat chalo: galat dawai symptoms chhupa sakti hai, theek kuch nahi karti. Reactive HIV test ko aur tests se confirm kiya jaata hai, aur treatment ke saath HIV wale log lambi aur healthy zindagi jee sakte hain [[who-hiv]].

Ab mushkil hissa: partners. Ilaaj se immunity nahi banti, isliye untreated partner infection wapas de deta hai. Isi wajah se partners ka treatment tumhare treatment ka hissa hai [[who-sti]]. Seedha kaho: "Mera chlamydia test positive aaya hai. Yeh curable hai. Tumhe bhi check karwana chahiye." Infection cheating ka saboot nahi hai; kai infections mahino ya saalon tak chup rehte hain. Agar partner ko batana unsafe lage, toh clinic ke counsellor se madad maango, aur agar koi dhamki de, toh 112 ya Women Helpline par call karo.

Theek feel karna koi result nahi hai. Result sirf test deta hai.

transgender-hiv-syphilis-health-gap.en:
Consider a 23-year-old trans woman in Lucknow. She is hypothetical; her day is not. She wants an HIV and syphilis test, so she goes to the district hospital. The registration slip has two boxes, male and female. The queue is split by gender. A clerk reads out the name on her old Aadhaar card, and heads turn. She leaves before her turn, untested.

Repeat that day across a country, add everything that happens before it, and you arrive at some of the starkest figures in India's sexual health data. In 2024, HIV prevalence among hijra and transgender people was 2.84%, about 14 times the 0.20% among all adults [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. At government STI clinics in 2024-25, 4.12% of syphilis screenings among transgender clients were reactive, against 1.54% among men and 0.48% among women [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## The numbers: HIV and syphilis far above average

Of the groups tracked by NACO, the National AIDS Control Organisation, only people who inject drugs had a higher HIV rate in 2024 (8.79%); men who have sex with men stood at 2.12% and female sex workers at 1.13% [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Government STI clinics ran 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings in 2024-25; 43,482, or 0.94%, were reactive [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Among transgender clients the rate was more than four times that average and more than eight times the rate among women. Syphilis is bacterial and curable once found, but many STIs cause no symptoms; only a test tells [[who-sti]].

Read the figures with care. The HIV rate comes from people the programme reaches, and clinic data count people who came in worried, not a random sample. Transgender clients were a tiny fraction of all screenings, which suggests most trans people never reach these clinics. Even the base is shaky: the government still uses the 4,87,803 people counted in the "other" gender category in Census 2011 [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]], widely seen as an undercount.

## Exclusion is a health risk

No gender identity carries a virus. HIV and syphilis spread through specific exposures, such as sex without a condom or a shared needle. What raises the odds for trans people is everything around those exposures.

It often starts at home. A child whose gender does not match the family's expectations may be beaten, taken to a "healer" or pushed out. Without family support, school ends early; without school or matching documents, formal jobs close. What remains is often informal or unsafe work, including sex work, where a person may have little power to insist on a condom. Each step adds risk and makes a clinic visit harder.

The law offers thin cover against violence: sexual abuse of a transgender person carries six months to two years in prison, a range the 2026 amendment left unchanged [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Then comes the clinic: two boxes on a form, a ward split by sex, a doctor who asks about "your wife". People humiliated once often do not come back.

## Shelters, clinics and the 2026 medical-board rule

State support is small next to the need. Under the SMILE scheme, launched on 12 February 2022, India had 21 Garima Greh shelters for destitute transgender persons, in 17 states, by November 2025 [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. In August 2025 the shelters then funded by the Social Justice Ministry housed 429 people; it had released Rs 8.25 crore to them [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Set that against a Census count of nearly five lakh, itself too low.

Legal recognition has moved backwards. In NALSA v. Union of India, on 15 April 2014, the Supreme Court upheld the right of transgender persons to self-identify their gender [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]], and the 2019 Act wrote "a right to self-perceived gender identity" into Section 4(2) [[indiacode-transgender-act-2019]]. The 2026 amendment, in force from 25 May 2026, deletes that sub-section: a District Magistrate now issues a transgender certificate only after examining the recommendation of a medical board headed by a Chief Medical Officer or a Deputy Chief Medical Officer [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Uptake has been low: by June 2026 only 33,189 certificates had been issued nationwide, about 7% of the Census count [[sc-kalki-subramaniam-petition-2026]].

For health, this cuts the wrong way. A community that already avoids hospitals must now pass a board of government doctors to be recognised in law, which risks teaching people to see doctors as examiners, not carers. The amendment is under challenge in the Supreme Court; on 17 August 2026 the Union told the court that identity cards already issued under the 2019 Act would continue to operate while the case is pending [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]].

## What respectful care looks like

Respectful care is not special treatment. It is the ordinary standard, applied to everyone:

- forms with more than two options, and staff who use the name and pronouns a person gives;
- questions about what kind of sex a person has, not guesses from appearance, because the right tests depend on it;
- HIV and syphilis tests offered routinely and done only with consent, plus the hepatitis B vaccine, since one exists [[who-sti]];
- PEP within 72 hours of a risky exposure or assault, taken for 28 days [[who-pep]], and PrEP for people at ongoing risk [[who-hiv]];
- mental health care without judgment, and no attempt to "cure" anyone.

Much of this is already law. The HIV Act, 2017 forbids HIV testing without informed consent, says no one can be forced to disclose their HIV status except by court order, and bars discrimination in healthcare against people living with HIV [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on any basis, naming gender, sex and sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Since a letter of 25 August 2022, the National Medical Commission treats "conversion therapy" on LGBTQIA+ persons as professional misconduct [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

## Where to go and what to ask for

India has 1,127 government STI clinics, branded Suraksha Clinics, at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Walk in and say: "I want an HIV test and a syphilis test." If a condom broke or you were assaulted in the last 72 hours, say that first; PEP cannot wait [[who-pep]]. A community organisation that works with trans and hijra people can tell you which clinics treat people well.

For confidential advice in 16 languages, at any hour, call NACO's helpline, 1097 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Tele-MANAS, 14416, offers free mental health counselling round the clock, including to transgender persons [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. If you are refused care or humiliated because of HIV, complain to your state's HIV Ombudsman; 34 states and union territories had one in March 2025 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

The 4.12% is not a fact about transgender bodies. It measures how far care still sits from the people who need it.
transgender-hiv-syphilis-health-gap.hg:
Lucknow ki ek 23 saal ki trans woman ko socho. Woh hypothetical hai; uska din nahi. Use HIV aur syphilis ka test karwana hai, toh woh district hospital jaati hai. Registration slip par do hi boxes hain, male aur female. Queue gender ke hisaab se bati hui hai. Clerk uske purane Aadhaar card wala naam zor se padhta hai, aur sabki nazrein uski taraf ghoom jaati hain. Apni baari aane se pehle hi woh nikal jaati hai, bina test ke.

Is ek din ko poore desh mein dohrao, usse pehle jo kuch hota hai woh sab jodo, aur tum India ke sexual health data ke sabse sakht numbers tak pahunch jaate ho. 2024 mein hijra aur transgender logon mein HIV prevalence 2.84% tha, sabhi adults ke 0.20% se lagbhag 14 guna [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Government STI clinics par 2024-25 mein transgender clients ki 4.12% syphilis screenings reactive nikli, jabki men mein yeh 1.54% aur women mein 0.48% tha [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Numbers: HIV aur syphilis average se bahut upar

NACO, yaani National AIDS Control Organisation, jin groups ko track karta hai, unmein 2024 mein sirf drugs inject karne wale logon ka HIV rate isse zyada tha (8.79%); men who have sex with men 2.12% par the aur female sex workers 1.13% par [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Government STI clinics ne 2024-25 mein 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings ki; 43,482, yaani 0.94%, reactive nikli [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Transgender clients mein rate is average se chaar guna se zyada aur women ke rate se aath guna se zyada tha. Syphilis bacterial hai aur pakad mein aa jaye toh cure ho jaata hai, lekin kai STIs mein koi symptom hota hi nahi; sirf test se pata chalta hai [[who-sti]].

In figures ko dhyan se padho. HIV rate un logon ka hai jin tak programme pahunchta hai, aur clinic data un logon ko ginta hai jo fikr mein khud chal kar aaye, yeh koi random sample nahi hai. Saari screenings mein transgender clients ka hissa bahut chhota tha, jisse lagta hai ki zyada tar trans log in clinics tak pahunchte hi nahi. Base bhi kachcha hai: government aaj bhi Census 2011 ki "other" gender category mein gine gaye 4,87,803 logon ka number use karti hai [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]], jise widely undercount maana jaata hai.

## Exclusion khud ek health risk hai

Koi bhi gender identity apne saath virus nahi laati. HIV aur syphilis specific exposures se phailte hain, jaise bina condom ke sex ya shared needle. Trans logon ke liye risk woh sab kuch badhata hai jo in exposures ke aas-paas hota hai.

Shuruaat aksar ghar se hoti hai. Jis bachche ka gender family ki expectations se match nahi karta, use maara ja sakta hai, kisi "healer" ke paas le jaya ja sakta hai ya ghar se nikaal diya ja sakta hai. Family support ke bina school jaldi chhoot jaata hai; school ya matching documents ke bina formal jobs ke darwaze band ho jaate hain. Jo bachta hai woh aksar informal ya unsafe kaam hota hai, sex work bhi, jahan condom par zor dene ki taaqat aksar kam hoti hai. Har step risk badhata hai aur clinic tak jaana aur mushkil kar deta hai.

Violence ke khilaaf law ka cover bhi patla hai: transgender person ke sexual abuse par chhe mahine se do saal ki jail hai, aur 2026 ke amendment ne yeh range waise ki waise chhod di [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Phir aata hai clinic: form par do boxes, sex ke hisaab se bata hua ward, aur doctor jo "aapki wife" ke baare mein poochta hai. Jis insaan ki ek baar beizzati ho jaye, woh aksar dobara nahi aata.

## Shelters, clinics aur 2026 ka medical-board rule

Zaroorat ke saamne state support bahut chhota hai. SMILE scheme ke under, jo 12 February 2022 ko launch hui, November 2025 tak India mein destitute transgender persons ke liye 21 Garima Greh shelters the, 17 states mein [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. August 2025 mein Social Justice Ministry se us waqt funded shelters mein 429 log reh rahe the; ministry ne unhe Rs 8.25 crore release kiye the [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Ise lagbhag paanch lakh ke Census count ke saamne rakho, jo khud bahut kam hai.

Legal recognition peeche gayi hai. NALSA v. Union of India mein, 15 April 2014 ko, Supreme Court ne transgender persons ke apna gender khud identify karne ke right ko uphold kiya [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]], aur 2019 ke Act ne Section 4(2) mein "a right to self-perceived gender identity" likha [[indiacode-transgender-act-2019]]. 2026 ka amendment, jo 25 May 2026 se lagu hai, yeh sub-section hata deta hai: ab District Magistrate transgender certificate tabhi issue karta hai jab woh ek medical board ki recommendation examine kar le, jiska head Chief Medical Officer ya Deputy Chief Medical Officer hota hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Uptake kam raha hai: June 2026 tak poore desh mein sirf 33,189 certificates issue hue the, Census count ka lagbhag 7% [[sc-kalki-subramaniam-petition-2026]].

Health ke liye yeh ulti disha hai. Jo community pehle se hospitals se bachti hai, use ab law mein recognition ke liye government doctors ke ek board se guzarna hoga. Isse risk yeh hai ki log doctors ko care dene wala nahi, examiner samajhne lagein. Is amendment ko Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai; 17 August 2026 ko Union ne court ko bataya ki 2019 Act ke under pehle se issue hue identity cards case pending rehne tak chalte rahenge [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]].

## Respectful care kaisi dikhti hai

Respectful care koi special treatment nahi hai. Yeh wahi ordinary standard hai, jo har kisi par lagu hona chahiye:

- forms jinmein do se zyada options hon, aur staff jo wahi naam aur pronouns use kare jo insaan khud bataye;
- yeh poochna ki insaan kis tarah ka sex karta hai, shakal dekhkar guess nahi karna, kyunki sahi tests isi par depend karte hain;
- HIV aur syphilis tests routine mein offer hon aur sirf consent se hon, saath mein hepatitis B vaccine, kyunki woh available hai [[who-sti]];
- risky exposure ya assault ke 72 ghante ke andar PEP, jo 28 din liya jaata hai [[who-pep]], aur ongoing risk wale logon ke liye PrEP [[who-hiv]];
- bina judgment ke mental health care, aur kisi ko "cure" karne ki koi koshish nahi.

Ismein se bahut kuch pehle se law hai. HIV Act, 2017 informed consent ke bina HIV testing mana karta hai, kehta hai ki court order ke bina kisi ko apna HIV status batane ke liye force nahi kiya ja sakta, aur HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke khilaaf healthcare mein discrimination par rok lagata hai [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka Section 21 mental health care mein kisi bhi basis par discrimination mana karta hai, aur gender, sex aur sexual orientation ka naam leta hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. 25 August 2022 ke ek letter ke baad se National Medical Commission LGBTQIA+ persons par "conversion therapy" ko professional misconduct maanta hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

## Kahan jaayein aur kya maangein

India mein 1,127 government STI clinics hain, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kaha jaata hai, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Andar jao aur bolo: "Mujhe HIV test aur syphilis test karwana hai." Agar pichhle 72 ghanton mein condom phata hai ya assault hua hai, toh yeh sabse pehle batao; PEP wait nahi kar sakta [[who-pep]]. Trans aur hijra logon ke saath kaam karne wali koi community organisation bata sakti hai ki kaun se clinics logon se achha bartaav karte hain.

Confidential advice ke liye, 16 languages mein, kisi bhi waqt, NACO ki helpline 1097 par call karo [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Tele-MANAS, 14416, din-raat free mental health counselling deta hai, transgender persons ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. HIV ki wajah se care se mana kiya jaye ya beizzati ho, toh apne state ke HIV Ombudsman se complaint karo; March 2025 mein 34 states aur union territories mein Ombudsman tha [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

4.12% transgender bodies ke baare mein koi fact nahi hai. Yeh naapta hai ki care aaj bhi un logon se kitni door baithi hai jinhe iski zaroorat hai.

undetectable-untransmittable-hiv-treatme.en:
Imagine a 30-year-old man in Indore who learned he had HIV three years ago. He takes his medicine every day, and his last viral-load test found too little virus to measure. Science is clear about what that means: as long as he stays that way, he does not pass HIV to his wife through sex [[who-hiv]]. Yet at family functions, an aunt still serves him on a separate plate. This story is about that gap, between what medicine has achieved and what people still believe.

## Myth: HIV-positive means infectious for life

The old picture of HIV is a virus that is always infectious and always fatal. Treatment changed both. There is still no cure [[who-hiv]], but antiretroviral therapy (ART), taken every day, keeps the virus from multiplying. The amount of virus in the blood falls, often until tests can no longer measure it.

At that point, WHO's position is plain: people living with HIV who take ART and have an undetectable viral load will not transmit HIV to their sexual partners [[who-hiv]]. This is U=U: undetectable equals untransmittable. It does not mean "lower risk". It means HIV is not passed on through sex.

Three conditions come with it. The person has to keep taking the medicine every day. Regular viral-load tests have to confirm that the virus stays undetectable. And U=U is about passing HIV on through sex, nothing else: it does not protect against other sexually transmitted infections, or against pregnancy.

## What "undetectable" means, and how a viral-load test checks it

An HIV test tells you whether you have the virus. A viral-load test is different. It measures how much virus is in your blood, and it is how an ART centre checks that treatment is working.

Two words matter. "Suppressed" means the virus is held at a very low level. "Undetectable" is the lowest level of all: so little virus that the test cannot measure it, and it is the level U=U refers to. The national figure below counts everyone who is suppressed, which includes people who are undetectable but is not limited to them. Your own report will say where you are. Ask for the result and what it means for your partner. It is your health record.

## 18.60 lakh on treatment: U=U in Indian numbers

In March 2025, 18.60 lakh people in India were on ART: 17.54 lakh at 800 government ART centres, where it is free, and an estimated 1.06 lakh in the private sector [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. At government centres, about 8.67 lakh were men, 7.98 lakh women, 7,000 hijra/transgender people and around 80,000 children [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

The medicine is working. In 2024-25, 97.6% of people on treatment whose viral load was tested had the virus suppressed, up from 84.9% in 2020-21 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. On this step, India has passed the UN target of 95%.

The weak links come earlier. In the same year, only 83.9% of people living with HIV knew their status, and 86.6% of those diagnosed were on treatment [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. U=U protects the partners of people who have been found and treated. Every person who has not been tested, or who drops out of care, is someone it cannot reach.

Between 2010 and 2024, estimated AIDS-related deaths in India fell by 81.4%, to 32,160 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. With treatment, people with HIV can lead long and healthy lives [[who-hiv]]. A diagnosis is no longer a death sentence.

## Myth: no marriage, no sex, no children

People with HIV can love, marry and have children. A person who stays undetectable does not pass HIV to a partner through sex [[who-hiv]]. Until a viral-load test confirms that, condoms greatly reduce the risk for the partner [[who-sti]]. A partner also needs to know, so they can make their own choices and get tested; counsellors at ART centres help people plan that conversation.

Children are possible too. WHO advises that pregnant women with HIV take treatment as soon as possible: it protects their own health and helps prevent HIV passing to the baby before birth or through breast milk [[who-hiv]]. India still has ground to cover. The estimated rate at which mothers with HIV pass it to their babies fell from more than 25% in 2020-21 to 10.25% in 2024-25 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. That is still roughly one baby in ten. Reaching mothers early is part of the gap: in 2024-25, 84% of pregnant women in India were tested for HIV, so about one in six was not [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Why stigma has not caught up with science

The science moved; public knowledge did not. In 2019-21, only 22% of women and 31% of men aged 15-49 in India had comprehensive knowledge of HIV, a level more or less unchanged since the previous survey [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Nearly half of women, 46%, did not know that HIV cannot spread through mosquito bites, and 55% did not know it cannot spread by sharing food with a person who has AIDS [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. That is the separate plate at the family function. If those basics have not reached people, the newer message, that treatment stops sexual transmission, is unlikely to have reached them either.

The law already recognises the problem. Section 3 of the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 bars discrimination against people with HIV, and against those who live with them, in jobs, healthcare, education, housing and insurance (unless backed by actuarial studies). It also specifically forbids isolating or segregating them [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

Two facts answer the fear. HIV does not spread through ordinary day-to-day contact, such as hugging or sharing food and water, whether or not a person is on treatment [[who-hiv]]. And with an undetectable viral load, it does not pass on through sex either. The real risk comes from HIV that has not been found and treated.

If you have HIV, the most powerful thing you can do for your partner is what you already do for yourself: take the medicine, and check your viral load. If you love someone with HIV, sit with them at the table. NACO's free helpline, 1097, offers confidential advice round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]].
undetectable-untransmittable-hiv-treatme.hg:
Ek hypothetical socho: Indore ka ek 30 saal ka aadmi, jise teen saal pehle pata chala ki use HIV hai. Woh roz medicine leta hai, aur uske pichhle viral-load test mein virus itna kam tha ki test use naap hi nahi paaya. Science iska matlab saaf batata hai: jab tak woh aisa hi rehta hai, sex ke through uski wife ko HIV nahi hoga [[who-hiv]]. Phir bhi family functions mein uski ek chachi use alag plate mein khana deti hain. Yeh story isi gap ke baare mein hai: medicine ne jo kar dikhaya hai, aur log aaj bhi jo maante hain.

## Myth: HIV-positive matlab zindagi bhar infectious

HIV ki purani tasveer hai ek aisa virus jo hamesha infectious aur hamesha fatal ho. Treatment ne dono baatein badal di. HIV ka cure ab bhi nahi hai [[who-hiv]], lekin antiretroviral therapy (ART) roz li jaye toh virus ko multiply hone se rokti hai. Blood mein virus ghat-ta jaata hai, aur aksar itna kam ho jaata hai ki test use naap nahi paate.

Is point par WHO ki position clear hai: jo log ART lete hain aur jinka viral load undetectable hai, woh apne sexual partners ko HIV transmit nahi karenge [[who-hiv]]. Ise U=U kehte hain: undetectable equals untransmittable. Iska matlab "thoda kam risk" nahi hai. Iska matlab hai ki sex ke through HIV aage nahi jaata.

Iske saath teen conditions hain. Medicine roz leni hogi. Regular viral-load tests se confirm hota rehna chahiye ki virus undetectable bana hua hai. Aur U=U sirf sex ke through HIV aage jaane ki baat hai, aur kuch nahi: yeh doosre sexually transmitted infections (STIs) se nahi bachata, aur na hi pregnancy se.

## "Undetectable" ka matlab kya hai, aur viral-load test ise kaise check karta hai

HIV test batata hai ki tumhe virus hai ya nahi. Viral-load test alag hai: yeh naapta hai ki tumhare blood mein kitna virus hai. ART centre isi se check karta hai ki treatment kaam kar raha hai ya nahi.

Do words samajhna zaroori hai. "Suppressed" ka matlab hai virus bahut low level par control mein hai. "Undetectable" sabse neeche ka level hai: virus itna kam ki test use naap hi na paaye, aur U=U isi level ki baat karta hai. Neeche diya gaya national figure un sab logon ko ginta hai jinka virus suppressed hai; isme undetectable wale bhi hain, par sirf wahi nahi. Tumhari apni report batayegi ki tum kahan ho. Result maango, aur poocho ki tumhare partner ke liye iska kya matlab hai. Yeh tumhara apna health record hai.

## 18.60 lakh treatment par: Indian numbers mein U=U

March 2025 mein India mein 18.60 lakh log ART par the: 17.54 lakh 800 government ART centres par, jahan treatment free hai, aur estimated 1.06 lakh private sector mein [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Government centres par lagbhag 8.67 lakh men, 7.98 lakh women, 7,000 hijra/transgender log aur kareeb 80,000 bachche treatment par the [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Medicine kaam kar rahi hai. 2024-25 mein treatment par jin logon ka viral load test hua, unme se 97.6% ka virus suppressed tha, jo 2020-21 mein 84.9% tha [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Is step par India UN ka 95% wala target paar kar chuka hai.

Kamzor kadiyan isse pehle ki hain. Usi saal HIV ke saath jee rahe sirf 83.9% logon ko apna status pata tha, aur diagnose hue logon mein se 86.6% treatment par the [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. U=U unhi ke partners ko protect karta hai jinka HIV pakda gaya aur treatment chal raha hai. Jisne test hi nahi karwaya, ya jisne treatment beech mein chhod diya, U=U us tak nahi pahunch sakta.

2010 se 2024 ke beech India mein AIDS se judi estimated deaths 81.4% ghat kar 32,160 reh gayi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Treatment ke saath HIV wale log lambi aur healthy life jee sakte hain [[who-hiv]]. Diagnosis ab death sentence nahi hai.

## Myth: na shaadi, na sex, na bachche

HIV wale log pyaar kar sakte hain, shaadi kar sakte hain aur bachche kar sakte hain. Jo undetectable bana rehta hai, woh partner ko sex ke through HIV pass nahi karta [[who-hiv]]. Jab tak viral-load test yeh confirm na kare, condom partner ka risk bahut kam kar deta hai [[who-sti]]. Partner ko pata hona bhi zaroori hai, taaki woh apne decisions khud le sake aur test karwa sake; ART centres ke counsellors is conversation ki planning mein help karte hain.

Bachche bhi possible hain. WHO kehta hai ki HIV wali pregnant women jitni jaldi ho sake treatment lein: isse unki apni health bachi rehti hai, aur baby tak janam se pehle ya breast milk ke through HIV jaane se rokne mein madad milti hai [[who-hiv]]. India ko abhi kaafi raasta tay karna hai. HIV wali maa se baby tak virus pahunchne ka estimated rate 2020-21 mein 25% se zyada tha, jo 2024-25 mein 10.25% hua [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yaani ab bhi lagbhag har das mein se ek baby tak. Maaon tak jaldi pahunchna bhi is gap ka hissa hai: 2024-25 mein India mein 84% pregnant women ka HIV test hua, yaani lagbhag har chhe mein se ek ka nahi hua [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

## Darr science se peeche kyun reh gaya

Science aage badh gaya, logon ki jaankari nahi badhi. 2019-21 mein 15-49 saal ki sirf 22% women aur 31% men ko HIV ki comprehensive knowledge thi, aur yeh level pichhle survey se lagbhag wahi ka wahi hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Lagbhag aadhi women, yaani 46%, ko yeh nahi pata tha ki HIV machhar ke kaatne se nahi failta, aur 55% ko nahi pata tha ki AIDS wale insaan ke saath khana share karne se bhi HIV nahi failta [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Family function wali alag plate yahi hai. Jab yeh basics hi logon tak nahi pahunche, toh nayi baat, ki treatment sexual transmission rok deta hai, unke paas pahunchi ho, iski ummeed kam hai.

Law pehle se is problem ko maanta hai. HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 ka Section 3 HIV wale logon, aur unke saath rehne walon, ke saath jobs, healthcare, education, housing aur insurance mein discrimination ko rokta hai (insurance mein farak tabhi ho sakta hai jab uske peeche actuarial studies hon). Yeh section saaf kehta hai ki unhe isolate ya segregate nahi kiya ja sakta [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

Do baatein is darr ka jawab hain. Gale milne ya khana-paani share karne jaise roz ke normal contact se HIV nahi failta, chahe insaan treatment par ho ya nahi [[who-hiv]]. Aur undetectable viral load ke saath sex ke through bhi HIV aage nahi jaata. Asli risk us HIV se hai jiska na pata chala, na treatment hua.

Agar tumhe HIV hai, toh partner ke liye sabse bada kaam wahi hai jo tum apne liye karte ho: medicine lo, aur viral load check karwate raho. Aur agar tumhara koi apna HIV ke saath jee raha hai, toh uske saath baith kar khana khao. NACO ki free helpline 1097 din-raat 16 languages mein confidential advice deti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

vasectomy-myths-nasbandi-weakness.en:
In NFHS-5, the national health survey of 2019-21, 37.9% of currently married women had been sterilised. The share relying on a husband's vasectomy was 0.3% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. That is more than a hundred women's operations for every man's. Nothing in medicine explains the ratio. A set of beliefs about what nasbandi does to a man explains it.

## The 0.3% problem

Female sterilisation alone accounts for about two thirds of all modern contraceptive use in India [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Both operations are permanent, and both are among the most effective methods there are [[who-fp]]. They are not the same size of operation.

To sterilise a woman, a surgeon has to reach the fallopian tubes inside her abdomen. A vasectomy blocks or cuts the vas deferens, the two thin tubes that carry sperm from the testicles [[who-fp]], and those lie just under the skin of the scrotum. It is done through a small opening under local anaesthesia, and the man walks home the same day.

> India has chosen the bigger operation, on the person who has already carried the pregnancies, more than a hundred times as often.

The word carries baggage too: in many families, nasbandi still brings back stories of target-driven sterilisation drives from the past. The standard today is the reverse: WHO says voluntary and informed choice is essential [[who-fp]]. Nobody may be pushed into the operation, and nobody should be scared away from it by rumours.

## Myth: it makes a man weak or impotent

The truth: a vasectomy does not affect male sexual performance [[who-fp]]. The reason is plumbing. The operation closes only the tubes that carry sperm. The testicles stay where they are and keep making testosterone, the hormone behind desire, muscle and beard, and it travels through the blood, not through those tubes. The nerves and blood vessels that produce an erection are not touched.

So a man can farm, lift, drive a truck or play kabaddi exactly as before once the small wound has healed. The belief that nasbandi finishes a man for heavy work has no basis in how the body works.

Erection trouble is common in men who have never been near a surgeon. It is usually caused by stress, tiredness, anxiety or alcohol, and when it keeps happening it can point to conditions such as diabetes or high blood pressure [[nhs-ed]]. A man who has difficulty after a vasectomy needs the same check-up as any other man. Anxiety, including worry about the operation itself, can be part of the cause.

## Myth: no semen, no manhood

The truth: ejaculation continues. A vasectomy keeps sperm out of the semen [[who-fp]], and sperm are only a small part of it. Most of the fluid comes from the prostate and the seminal vesicles, which the operation does not touch. What a man sees and feels stays the same. The sperm his testicles go on making are simply absorbed by the body.

Underneath this myth sits an older one: that semen is stored strength, and losing it drains a man. It does not. Semen is not made from blood, and the body replaces it continuously. A vasectomy does not even involve losing it.

These ideas about manhood have been measured. A 2014 ICRW-UNFPA survey of 9,205 men in seven Indian states classified 32% as holding "rigid" masculinity, 45% as moderate and only 23% as gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. The survey did not ask about vasectomy. It shows the ground the myth grows in: where manhood means control and potency, an operation near the testicles feels like a threat, whatever the doctor says.

## What it really involves: the procedure, the waiting period, no STI protection

A vasectomy is short, done under local anaesthesia, and available at government hospitals, including by the "no-scalpel" technique. Three facts matter more than any rumour.

It does not work at once. There is a delay while stored sperm is still present [[who-fp]], so for the first few months the couple needs condoms or another method, until a semen test shows the sperm are gone. A pregnancy in that window is the waiting period ignored, not the operation failing.

It is permanent. Reversal surgery exists but cannot promise fertility back, so a man should decide only when he is sure he wants no more children. Nobody else may decide for him.

It gives no protection against infections. Condoms are the only contraceptive that also protects against STIs, including HIV [[who-fp]], and many STIs cause no symptoms [[who-sti]].

## Who pays when men opt out

In NFHS-5, 35.1% of men agreed that contraception is "women's business and a man should not have to worry about it" [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The method mix is that sentence turned into surgery. In the same survey, 5.4% of married women wanted no more children yet were using no method at all [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In those homes, a husband's vasectomy is one way to settle the question.

Consider a couple in Gorakhpur with two children, sure they want no more. The health worker mentions "the operation", and everyone assumes she means the wife's. He has heard that nasbandi finishes a man for field work. Nobody tells him that his procedure would be the smaller one, or that his body would work as before. So she is the one who goes into surgery, as she was the one who went through two pregnancies.

A man whose family is complete can change that with one conversation with a doctor. Manhood was never stored in two thin tubes.
vasectomy-myths-nasbandi-weakness.hg:
NFHS-5 mein, yaani 2019-21 ke national health survey mein, 37.9% currently married aurton ka sterilisation ho chuka tha. Pati ki vasectomy par tiki aurton ka hissa 0.3% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yaani mard ke har ek operation par aurton ke sau se zyada operation. Medicine mein aisa kuch nahi jo is ratio ko samjha sake. Ise samjhati hain woh dhaarnayein ki nasbandi mard ke saath kya karti hai.

## 0.3% wali problem

Akela female sterilisation India ke saare modern contraceptive use ka lagbhag do-tihaai hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Dono operation permanent hain, aur dono sabse effective methods mein gine jaate hain [[who-fp]]. Lekin dono operation ek size ke nahi hain.

Aurat ke sterilisation ke liye surgeon ko uske pet (abdomen) ke andar fallopian tubes tak pahunchna padta hai. Vasectomy mein vas deferens ko block kiya ya kaata jaata hai, yaani woh do patli tubes jo testicles se sperm le jaati hain [[who-fp]], aur yeh scrotum ki skin ke theek neeche hoti hain. Yeh local anaesthesia mein ek chhote se opening se hoti hai, aur mard usi din chal kar ghar jaata hai.

> India ne bada operation chuna hai, us insaan par jo pehle hi pregnancies jhel chuki hai, aur woh bhi sau guna se zyada baar.

Is shabd ke saath purana bojh bhi juda hai: kai parivaaron mein nasbandi sunte hi beete zamaane ki target wali sterilisation drives ki kahaniyan yaad aa jaati hain. Aaj ka standard iska ulta hai: WHO kehta hai ki voluntary aur informed choice zaroori hai [[who-fp]]. Kisi ko bhi operation ke liye majboor nahi kiya ja sakta, aur kisi ko afwaahon ki wajah se usse door bhi nahi rehna chahiye.

## Myth: isse mard kamzor ya impotent ho jaata hai

Sach yeh hai: vasectomy ka male sexual performance par koi asar nahi padta [[who-fp]]. Wajah seedhi plumbing hai. Operation sirf un tubes ko band karta hai jo sperm le jaati hain. Testicles apni jagah rehte hain aur testosterone banate rehte hain, wahi hormone jo desire, muscles aur daadhi ke peechhe hai, aur yeh khoon ke raaste chalta hai, un tubes se nahi. Erection banane wali nerves aur blood vessels ko chhua tak nahi jaata.

Isliye chhota sa ghaav bharne ke baad mard pehle ki tarah hi kheti kar sakta hai, wazan utha sakta hai, truck chala sakta hai ya kabaddi khel sakta hai. Yeh maanyata ki nasbandi ke baad mard bhaari kaam ke laayak nahi rehta, shareer ke kaam karne ke tareeke se kahin mel nahi khaati.

Erection ki dikkat un mardon mein bhi aam hai jo kabhi surgeon ke paas gaye hi nahi. Aam taur par iski wajah stress, thakaan, anxiety ya sharaab hoti hai, aur jab yeh baar-baar ho toh diabetes ya high blood pressure jaisi conditions ki taraf ishaara kar sakti hai [[nhs-ed]]. Jis mard ko vasectomy ke baad dikkat ho, use wahi check-up chahiye jo kisi bhi doosre mard ko. Anxiety, jismein operation ki fikr bhi shaamil hai, iski ek wajah ho sakti hai.

## Myth: semen nahi, toh mardangi nahi

Sach yeh hai: ejaculation jaari rehta hai. Vasectomy sperm ko semen se bahar rakhti hai [[who-fp]], aur sperm semen ka bas ek chhota sa hissa hai. Zyadatar fluid prostate aur seminal vesicles se aata hai, jinhe operation chhoota bhi nahi. Mard jo dekhta aur mehsoos karta hai, woh waisa hi rehta hai. Testicles jo sperm banate rehte hain, unhe shareer seedha absorb kar leta hai.

Is myth ke neeche ek aur purana myth baitha hai: ki semen jama ki hui taaqat hai, aur uske nikalne se mard khokhla ho jaata hai. Aisa nahi hota. Semen khoon se nahi banta, aur shareer use lagaataar banata rehta hai. Vasectomy mein toh semen jaata bhi nahi.

Mardangi ke in khayalon ko naapa bhi gaya hai. 2014 ke ICRW-UNFPA survey ne saat Indian states ke 9,205 mardon mein se 32% ko "rigid" masculinity wala, 45% ko moderate aur sirf 23% ko gender-equitable classify kiya [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Survey ne vasectomy ke baare mein nahi poochha tha. Woh bas woh zameen dikhata hai jismein yeh myth ugta hai: jahan mardangi ka matlab control aur potency ho, wahan testicles ke paas ka operation khatra lagta hai, doctor chahe kuch bhi kahe.

## Asal mein hota kya hai: procedure, waiting period, aur STI se koi protection nahi

Vasectomy chhoti hoti hai, local anaesthesia mein hoti hai, aur government hospitals mein uplabdh hai, "no-scalpel" tareeke se bhi. Teen facts kisi bhi afwaah se zyada zaroori hain.

Yeh turant kaam nahi karti. Jab tak pehle se jama sperm maujood hai, asar mein der lagti hai [[who-fp]], isliye pehle kuch mahinon tak couple ko condom ya koi aur method chahiye, jab tak semen test na dikha de ki sperm khatm ho chuke hain. Is window mein hui pregnancy operation ka fail hona nahi hai; woh waiting period ko nazarandaaz karna hai.

Yeh permanent hai. Reversal surgery hoti hai lekin fertility lautne ka vaada nahi kar sakti, isliye mard tabhi decide kare jab use pakka ho ki aur bachche nahi chahiye. Uski jagah koi aur yeh faisla nahi le sakta.

Yeh infections se koi protection nahi deti. Condom akela contraceptive hai jo STIs, HIV samet, se bhi bachata hai [[who-fp]], aur kai STIs mein koi symptom nahi hota [[who-sti]].

## Jab mard peechhe hat-te hain toh keemat kaun chukata hai

NFHS-5 mein 35.1% mardon ne maana ki contraception "aurton ka kaam hai, mard ko iski fikr karne ki zaroorat nahi" [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Method mix usi vaakya ko surgery mein badal deta hai. Usi survey mein 5.4% shaadishuda aurtein aur bachche nahi chahti thi, phir bhi koi method use nahi kar rahi thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Aise gharon mein pati ki vasectomy is sawaal ko suljhane ka ek raasta hai.

Gorakhpur ke ek couple ke baare mein sochiye, jinke do bachche hain aur jinhe pakka hai ki aur nahi chahiye. Health worker "operation" ka zikr karti hai, aur sab maan lete hain ki baat patni ke operation ki ho rahi hai. Pati ne suna hai ki nasbandi ke baad mard khet ke kaam ka nahi rehta. Koi use nahi batata ki uska procedure chhota wala hoga, ya uska shareer pehle jaisa hi kaam karega. Toh surgery mein wahi jaati hai, jaise do pregnancies se bhi wahi guzri thi.

Jis mard ki family complete ho chuki hai, woh doctor se ek baatcheet karke yeh badal sakta hai. Mardangi kabhi do patli tubes mein rakhi hi nahi thi.

women-sti-clinics-men-syphilis-positivit.en:
Walk into the STI clinic of an Indian district hospital and most of the people waiting will be women. Open the lab register and the pattern flips. In 2024-25, government Suraksha Clinics recorded 71.95 lakh visits, 60.9% of them by women. In the same clinics, 1.54% of syphilis tests on men came back reactive, against 0.48% of tests on women [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Women are the majority at the door. Men are the majority of the positives. A large part of India's STI problem sits in the gap between those two facts.

## Who walks into India's STI clinics

NACO, the National AIDS Control Organisation, runs 1,127 Designated STI/RTI Clinics, branded Suraksha Clinics, at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. In 2024-25 the programme managed about 1.12 crore STI/RTI cases, including the 71.95 lakh visits at these clinics [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. These are visits, not people: someone who came three times is counted three times.

Why so many women? The "RTI" in the name is part of the answer. The clinics also treat reproductive tract infections, and a common one such as thrush is not classed as a sexually transmitted infection at all [[nhs-thrush]]. Women also meet the health system in ways men do not: at antenatal check-ups and in the gynaecology queue. A woman with discharge or pain has a route into the clinic. A man usually has to decide, alone, to walk through a door marked for the one thing he does not want to be seen with.

## Who tests positive

Syphilis is checked with a blood test, not judged by symptoms, so it gives the clearest view of who is actually infected. In 2024-25 the clinics ran 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings, and 43,482, or 0.94%, were reactive [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

| Clients | Syphilis positivity (2024-25) |
|---|---|
| Women | 0.48% |
| Men | 1.54% |
| Hijra/transgender | 4.12% |

NACO's table shows that fewer men than women were screened, yet men produced more than twice as many reactive results: more than two in three positives were men [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Transgender clients, a tiny share of those screened, had the highest rate of all.

Geography sharpens the picture. Syphilis positivity among clinic attendees was 14% in Arunachal Pradesh, 11% in Sikkim, 7% in Meghalaya and 4% in Mizoram, against a national average of 0.9% [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Read this with care. Clinic attendees are a self-selected group, not a sample of the population. The table does not show that 1.54% of Indian men have syphilis. It shows that the men who reach a clinic are far more likely to carry it than the women who do. One reading: women come early and often, for many reasons, while men come late, and only when something has clearly gone wrong.

## Where the men go instead

No statistic counts the men who never arrive. NACO's figures are programme data: STIs treated by private doctors and unqualified practitioners do not appear in them [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Consider a hypothetical 27-year-old in Kanpur who notices a painless sore. He will not go to the district hospital, where a neighbour might see him. He asks a chemist for "something strong", or calls a number painted on a wall that promises to cure "gupt rog". Within weeks the sore is gone and he believes he is cured. But the first sore of syphilis heals by itself, treated or not, while the bacteria stay in the body and can still be passed on [[who-syphilis]]. A year later his wife's antenatal blood test comes back positive, and her in-laws ask where she got it.

Those wall advertisements are themselves illegal. Under the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954, advertising a drug as a treatment for venereal diseases, including syphilis and gonorrhoea, is a crime; a first conviction carries up to six months in jail, a fine, or both. On 26 March 2025 the Supreme Court said "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit" [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Partners carry the cost. India identified 10,545 pregnant women with syphilis in 2024-25 [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Each was found because pregnancy brought her to a clinic. Nothing brings her husband.

## Treating symptoms, missing infections

There is a second blind spot, inside the clinic. STI care in India largely follows the syndromic approach: the health worker identifies a pattern of symptoms, such as discharge or a genital sore, and treats the infections that usually cause it, without waiting for a laboratory [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. WHO says the method is simple and allows same-day treatment, but leads to overtreatment and missed treatment, because the majority of STIs cause no symptoms [[who-sti]]. Chlamydia, for one, often produces no signs, and untreated it can cause infertility [[who-chlamydia]].

So the system finds people who hurt and who come in. A woman with no symptoms whose husband has an untreated infection does neither. Nor does the man whose sore has healed.

## Bringing men and partners in

Treating one half of a couple does not work, because the infection passes back. Treating sexual partners is part of the cure, not an extra [[who-sti]].

India already has proof that following the chain finds infections. When NACO tested 6.6 lakh spouses, partners and children of people living with HIV in 2024-25, 4.1% were positive, about ten times the 0.40% among all at-risk people tested [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. The infections were there. Someone had to ask.

Applied to STIs, that means a referral slip for the partner with every prescription, a syphilis test for the husband of every pregnant woman who tests positive, clinic hours a working man can keep, and staff who treat a male patient as a patient, not a confession. Men whose partners are men need the same tests without judgment. None of this needs new science: syphilis, gonorrhoea and chlamydia are curable [[who-sti]].

If you are a man reading this, a symptom that disappeared is not a cure, and a chemist is not a clinic. NACO's free, confidential helpline, 1097, can advise you on testing and where to go [[naco]]. Go, and take your partner or tell them. Women already make most of the visits. The numbers will not move until men make theirs.
women-sti-clinics-men-syphilis-positivit.hg:
India ke kisi bhi district hospital ke STI clinic mein jao, wait karne walon mein zyada tar women milengi. Lab ka register kholo toh pattern ulta ho jaata hai. 2024-25 mein government Suraksha Clinics mein 71.95 lakh visits record hui, jinmein se 60.9% women ki thin. Unhi clinics mein men ke 1.54% syphilis tests reactive aaye, jabki women ke 0.48% [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Darwaze par majority women ki hai. Positive results mein majority men ki hai. India ki STI problem ka ek bada hissa in dono facts ke beech ke gap mein baitha hai.

## India ke STI clinics mein kaun aata hai

NACO, yaani National AIDS Control Organisation, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Designated STI/RTI Clinics chalata hai, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kehte hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. 2024-25 mein programme ne lagbhag 1.12 crore STI/RTI cases sambhale, jinmein in clinics ki 71.95 lakh visits shaamil hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh visits ki ginti hai, logon ki nahi: jo insaan teen baar aaya, woh teen baar gina gaya.

Itni zyada women kyun? Jawab ka ek hissa naam ke "RTI" mein hai. Yeh clinics reproductive tract infections ka bhi ilaaj karte hain, aur thrush jaisa common infection sexually transmitted infection maana hi nahi jaata [[nhs-thrush]]. Women health system se aise mauqon par milti hain jahan men nahi milte: antenatal check-ups mein aur gynaecology ki line mein. Jis aurat ko discharge ya dard hai, uske paas clinic tak pahunchne ka ek raasta hai. Aadmi ko aksar akele yeh faisla karna padta hai ki woh us darwaze se andar jaaye jis par usi cheez ka board laga hai jiske saath woh dikhna nahi chahta.

## Positive kaun aata hai

Syphilis blood test se check hota hai, symptoms dekh kar andaaza nahi lagaya jaata, isliye yahi sabse saaf dikhata hai ki infection asal mein kisko hai. 2024-25 mein clinics ne 46.2 lakh syphilis screenings ki, aur 43,482, yaani 0.94%, reactive aayi [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

| Clients | Syphilis positivity (2024-25) |
|---|---|
| Women | 0.48% |
| Men | 1.54% |
| Hijra/transgender | 4.12% |

NACO ki table dikhati hai ki men ki screening women se kam hui, phir bhi men ke reactive results women se double se zyada nikle: har teen positive mein se do se zyada men the [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Transgender clients, jo screening mein bahut chhota hissa the, unka rate sabse upar tha.

Geography tasveer ko aur saaf karti hai. Clinic aane walon mein syphilis positivity Arunachal Pradesh mein 14% thi, Sikkim mein 11%, Meghalaya mein 7% aur Mizoram mein 4%, jabki national average 0.9% hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Ise dhyaan se padho. Clinic aane wale log khud chun kar aaya hua group hain, poori population ka sample nahi. Yeh table yeh nahi dikhati ki India ke 1.54% men ko syphilis hai. Yeh dikhati hai ki jo men clinic tak pahunchte hain, unmein yeh infection hone ke chances wahan pahunchne wali women se kahin zyada hain. Ise padhne ka ek tareeka: women jaldi aur baar-baar aati hain, kai wajahon se, jabki men der se aate hain, aur tabhi jab kuch saaf-saaf bigad chuka hota hai.

## Toh men jaate kahan hain

Jo men kabhi clinic pahunchte hi nahi, unhe koi statistic nahi ginta. NACO ke figures programme data hain: private doctors aur unqualified practitioners ne jin STIs ka ilaaj kiya, woh inmein aate hi nahi [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Ek hypothetical socho: Kanpur ka 27 saal ka ek aadmi, jise ek painless ghaav dikhta hai. Woh district hospital nahi jaayega, kyunki wahan koi padosi dekh sakta hai. Woh chemist se "koi strong dawai" maangta hai, ya deewar par likhe us number par call karta hai jo "gupt rog" theek karne ka waada karta hai. Kuch hafton mein ghaav gayab ho jaata hai aur use lagta hai ki woh theek ho gaya. Lekin syphilis ka pehla ghaav apne aap bhar jaata hai, ilaaj ho ya na ho, jabki bacteria body mein rehte hain aur aage bhi fail sakte hain [[who-syphilis]]. Ek saal baad uski wife ka antenatal blood test positive aata hai, aur sasural wale poochhte hain ki use yeh kahan se laga.

Deewaron ke yeh ads khud gair-kanooni hain. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 ke tahat kisi drug ko venereal diseases ke ilaaj ke roop mein advertise karna crime hai, jismein syphilis aur gonorrhoea shaamil hain; pehli conviction par chhe mahine tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain. 26 March 2025 ko Supreme Court ne kaha: "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit" [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Keemat partners chukate hain. India ne 2024-25 mein 10,545 pregnant women mein syphilis pehchaana [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Har ek ka pata isliye chala ki pregnancy use clinic tak le aayi. Uske husband ko clinic tak laane wali koi cheez nahi hai.

## Symptoms ka ilaaj, infections miss

Ek doosra blind spot bhi hai, clinic ke andar. India mein STI care zyada tar syndromic approach par chalti hai: health worker symptoms ka pattern pehchaanta hai, jaise discharge ya genital ghaav, aur lab ka wait kiye bina un infections ka ilaaj kar deta hai jo aksar iski wajah hote hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. WHO kehta hai ki yeh tareeka simple hai aur usi din treatment de deta hai, lekin isse overtreatment bhi hota hai aur kai infections chhoot bhi jaate hain, kyunki zyada tar STIs ke koi symptoms hi nahi hote [[who-sti]]. Chlamydia hi le lo: aksar iske koi signs nahi hote, aur ilaaj na ho toh yeh infertility ki wajah ban sakta hai [[who-chlamydia]].

Yaani system unhe dhoondh paata hai jinhe takleef hai aur jo khud chal kar aate hain. Jis aurat ko koi symptom nahi aur jiske husband ka infection untreated hai, woh in dono mein nahi aati. Na hi woh aadmi aata hai jiska ghaav bhar chuka hai.

## Men aur partners ko andar kaise laayein

Couple mein se sirf ek ka ilaaj kaam nahi karta, kyunki infection wapas aa jaata hai. Sexual partners ka treatment ilaaj ka hissa hai, koi extra cheez nahi [[who-sti]].

India ke paas pehle se saboot hai ki chain ko follow karne se infections milte hain. 2024-25 mein jab NACO ne HIV ke saath jee rahe logon ke 6.6 lakh spouses, partners aur bachchon ka test kiya, toh 4.1% positive nikle, jo sabhi at-risk logon ke 0.40% ka lagbhag das guna hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Infections wahan the. Bas kisi ko poochhna tha.

STIs par yahi logic lagao toh matlab hai: har prescription ke saath partner ke liye referral slip, har us pregnant woman ke husband ka syphilis test jiska result positive aaye, clinic ke aise timings jo kaam karne wala aadmi nibha sake, aur aisa staff jo male patient ko patient samjhe, gunaah kabool karne wala nahi. Jin men ke partners men hain, unhe bhi wahi tests chahiye, bina judgment ke. Ismein kisi nayi science ki zaroorat nahi: syphilis, gonorrhoea aur chlamydia curable hain [[who-sti]].

Agar tum ek aadmi ho aur yeh padh rahe ho, toh yaad rakho: symptom ka gayab ho jaana ilaaj nahi hai, aur chemist clinic nahi hai. NACO ki free aur confidential helpline 1097 testing aur kahan jaana hai, iske baare mein salah de sakti hai [[naco]]. Jao, aur apne partner ko saath le jao ya unhe batao. Zyada tar visits pehle se women kar rahi hain. Numbers tab tak nahi hilenge jab tak men apni visits nahi karte.
